1	# Proxy servers and VPSs
2	
3	`setup` installs a Mihomo client. `servers deploy` installs a proxy server;
4	`vps` manages its machine. A server/VPS is not a controller target.
5	
6	Start with `vps catalog --json`, `vps list --json`, `servers recipes --json`
7	and `servers list --json`. Catalog prices are dated references; quote the actual
8	provider region/plan before creating a machine. Oracle, Vultr, Linode,
9	DigitalOcean, Azure, AWS Lightsail and EC2 use their official authenticated CLIs.
10	API credentials remain there. Provider IDs are `azure`, `aws-lightsail` and
11	`aws-ec2`; Azure uses explicit `--subscription`, AWS uses the existing `--profile`.
12	Use a public key file for all three. No global CLI account defaults are changed.
13	
14	`vps guide [ID] --provider PROVIDER [--region REGION]` prints a copyable hybrid
15	runbook: CLI installation/login, original official CLI queries, then lazyclash
16	discovery, preview, reviewed apply and recovery. `--format agent` adds a handoff
17	prompt; `--json` returns structured steps. Generation is offline and only checks
18	PATH, even with broken settings. It never reads credentials or runs commands.
19	Missing inputs use guarded `${LC_*:?}` shell variables; resolve them from the
20	actual account rather than inventing IDs. Installation commands are explicitly
21	labeled macOS/Homebrew; use the linked vendor instructions on other platforms.
22	Oracle defaults to browser sessions and scopes `OCI_CLI_AUTH=security_token` to
23	the emitted commands; use `--oci-auth api_key` for an existing API-key profile.
24	Explicit config/inventory scope is preserved; adjust local paths when handing
25	off to a different machine. Run one step at a time within the user's authorized
26	scope, review costs and identity before assigning the exact preview digest, and
27	never turn this document into an automatically approved script. Official CLI
28	queries bypass catalog filters for diagnosis; managed writes still use lazyclash
29	receipts and reconciliation. Missing/free-tier eligibility stays unknown.
30	Oracle only offers a checked Always Free A1 recipe; unknown eligibility or
31	capacity does not authorize a paid substitute.
32	New owned Oracle VMs receive a version/hash-bound cloud-init that preserves
33	platform INPUT rules and permits TCP 80/443 and UDP 443 at boot. It is never
34	applied to registered existing hosts. Custom ports need separate firewall review.
35	
36	Existing public-IP homelabs, Azure VMs and arbitrary VPSs use `vps register ID
37	--ssh-host ALIAS --public-host HOST`. The SSH address may be private and use
38	OpenSSH jump hosts; it is independent of the public client endpoint. Router
39	forwarding, cloud firewall and host firewall are separate. SSH-only hosts cannot
40	be powered on remotely after shutdown without a provider management interface.
41	
42	Oracle/Azure `vps usage HOST` and `servers usage SERVER` query the current UTC
43	month without writes; `--month YYYY-MM` selects a past UTC month and `--json`
44	preserves structured observations. `--read-only` is supported. The full month
45	must fit Monitoring retention (Oracle 90 days, Azure 93 days); future months and
46	older incomplete windows fail before cloud queries. TUI Servers / VPS uses `u`
47	for explicit current-month refresh; normal Overview does not poll cloud APIs.
48	Registered hosts need `vps bind-cloud HOST --provider oracle|azure --region REGION
49	--resource-id ID` plus Oracle `--tenancy`/optional `--profile`, or Azure explicit
50	`--subscription`. Preview first, then repeat with the exact reviewed `--yes
51	--expect DIGEST`. This only saves observation metadata; it never grants cloud
52	ownership or changes VM lifecycle authority. Keep the same inventory scope.
53	VM network bytes, provider billing meters and published shared allowances are
54	separate. Missing/stale samples are unknown, not zero. Preserve native billing
55	units, including `GB Months`, `10 GB` and `1 TB`; do not infer a byte conversion,
56	remaining quota, percentage, trial-credit balance or overage. Oracle billing is
57	tenancy-scoped; Azure Bandwidth billing is subscription-scoped and supports legacy
58	Usage Details only (EA/MCA Cost Details remains unsupported). Billing failures
59	do not erase readable VM observations; Disabled Azure subscriptions may retain
60	readable history. Multiple target imports share the same VPS usage source.
61	See the [VPS usage guide](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/lazyclash/blob/main/docs/vps-usage.md)
62	for binding examples, data sources and reporting limitations.
63	
64	Azure/AWS creation defaults to Ubuntu 24.04 and at least 1 GiB RAM. `--architecture
65	auto|amd64|arm64` controls plan compatibility; auto allows ARM. Omitted plans are
66	resolved using available low fixed-cost plans in the requested region. Inspect
67	the fixed image ID/version, architecture and availability zone in the preview.
68	`--availability-zone` pins a zone; Azure/EC2 `--disk-gb` overrides their default
69	32 GiB Standard SSD / 20 GiB encrypted gp3 root disk. Azure/EC2 image IDs are fixed.
70	Lightsail uses the verified Ubuntu 24.04 x86 blueprint and rechecks its saved
71	version immediately before launch; its API accepts only the blueprint ID.
72	Azure/EC2 quote `monthly_usd` includes compute, root disk and static IPv4, with
73	components and stopped costs. Lightsail bundles include the base resources;
74	`vps estimate --egress N --ingress N` accounts for its two-way allowance. Missing
75	inbound remains uncertain, and shared account free traffic/credits are not
76	per-VM discounts. CPU credits and region capacity remain material constraints.
77	Use `discover --kind subscriptions` for Azure; `--kind zones` for Azure/AWS.
78	
79	Server recipes are `vless-reality`, `hysteria2`, `legacy-vmess-ws-tls`.
80	Remote OS is Ubuntu 24.04 LTS amd64/arm64; native systemd is default and Compose
81	is optional. BYO Compose requires working Docker/Compose. Server management
82	requires root SSH or noninteractive sudo for the fixed Python helper.
83	Hysteria2 needs UDP and a trusted certificate; TLS recipes require DNS plus
84	TCP 80 for ACME renewal. Do not turn off certificate verification to hide errors.
85	
86	New server deployments default to pinned Xray v26.10.29 / Hysteria app/v2.13.0;
87	`--version latest` explicitly opts into an untested upstream release, still
88	resolved to an immutable artifact in the preview. New standalone Mihomo installs
89	and downloaded temporary verifiers use v1.19.33. Existing services are not upgraded.
90	HY2 accepts `--obfs none|salamander` (default none); the independent obfuscation
91	[REDACTED:generic-credential-uri] is generated on apply, retained on resume and included in client shares.
92	Salamander removes standard HTTP/3 compatibility and cannot bypass a general UDP
93	block. Do not invent bandwidth hints or enable advanced transport options.
94	
95	Complete noninteractive commands produce a preview. Apply with `--yes --expect`
96	and the exact reviewed digest. Bare `servers deploy` / `vps create` guide humans
97	in a terminal; JSON never prompts. Keep the same `--servers-config` across stages.
98	The default inventory is `servers.toml` beside the chosen client settings;
99	private journals are stored under XDG state, isolated by inventory path.
100	
101	Cloud create intent and returned resource IDs are durable before SSH deployment.
102	An interrupted create can have succeeded: `vps resume ID` reconciles the exact
103	operation marker, never blindly issues another ambiguous create. Preserve
104	partial resources and ownership records. Server resume retains credentials,
105	issued certificates and completed phases. Inspection precedes retries.
106	`vps resume ID --reconcile-only` saves only existing resources, without creating
107	or attaching cloud resources; use it to recover an unknown create before cleanup.
108	
109	`servers start/stop/restart/remove` operate the proxy service. `vps start/stop/
110	reboot/delete` operate cloud infrastructure. Stopping a service or VM does not
111	generally stop billing. Delete only the reviewed owned resources; shared networks,
112	firewalls and keys are not cleanup authority.
113	Azure stop deallocates but retains disk/IP charges; EC2 stop retains EBS/EIP
114	charges. Lightsail stop retains its bundle charge. These new providers create
115	dedicated owned networks/resources rather than taking over an existing VPC or
116	resource group; no NAT Gateway or IAM role is created. EC2 uses IMDSv2 and
117	Standard CPU credits. Azure cloud/tenant/subscription or AWS partition/account
118	is bound to recovery; do not change account, AZ or idempotency token to retry an
119	ambiguous create. Lightsail static IP ownership uses saved receipts, not tags.
120	
121	Status distinguishes service state, SSH and last authenticated HTTPS proxy
122	verification. Verification uses an isolated temporary Mihomo with no direct
123	fallback. A running service does not prove Mainland connectivity; a failed probe
124	does not erase the deployment. Incoming IP and observed exit IP may differ.
125	An existing TUN with TLS destination overrides can intercept an independent
126	REALITY verifier. After diagnosing that route, `deploy/resume/start/restart
127	--verify-interface NAME` explicitly binds only the temporary verifier to a local
128	interface; it never rewrites a live client or system routing. The default keeps
129	system routing, and successful status records the chosen verification interface.
130	
131	`servers export ID --format uri|qr|mihomo|starter|client-bundle|admin-bundle`
132	is an explicit credential export. QR/admin exports require a new private output
133	file. Ordinary sharing contains client credentials; the explicit admin backup
134	also includes server keys/issued TLS files and restore metadata, never cloud
135	tokens or SSH private keys. Do not put these bundles in public repositories.
136	New REALITY nodes include `support-x25519mlkem768: true`; standard VLESS URI/QR
137	cannot preserve this option, so use Mihomo YAML or starter instead. Client bundles
138	always preserve the full configuration; `uri` is optional and `warnings` explains
139	its absence. Admin backups work independently of URI support. Legacy journals
140	retain their original compatibility profile and share encoding.
141	
142	`--target CLIENT servers connect ID --group GROUP` previews insertion through the
143	existing node-source owner. It does not replace the user's routing profile.
144	If persistence/reload is uncertain, inspect/verify the saved import receipt rather
145	than importing a duplicate. Verge still needs native profile reactivation.
146

```text
1	package vps
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"fmt"
6		"net"
7		"strconv"
8		"strings"
9	
10		"github.com/daviddwlee84/lazyclash/internal/serverstate"
11	)
12	
13	// CLI syntax follows the providers' official references:
14	// https://docs.digitalocean.com/reference/doctl/reference/compute/firewall/create/
15	// https://docs.vultr.com/reference/vultr-cli/firewall/rule/create
16	// https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/post-firewalls
17	// An owned firewall is prepared before the instance is created. Unknown creates
18	// are reconciled by the persisted, unique operation name, never blindly retried.
19	
20	func firewallOwned(host serverstate.Host, id string) bool {
21		for _, r := range host.Resources {
22			if r.Kind == "firewall" && r.ID == id && r.Owned {
23				return true
24			}
25		}
26		return false
27	}
28	
29	func addFirewallResource(host *serverstate.Host, kind, id string, owned bool) {
30		for _, r := range host.Resources {
31			if r.Kind == kind && r.ID == id {
32				return
33			}
34		}
35		host.Resources = append(host.Resources, serverstate.Resource{Kind: kind, ID: id, Owned: owned})
36	}
37	
38	func (s *Service) persistFirewall(op *operation) error {
39		if err := s.writeOperation(*op); err != nil {
40			return err
41		}
42		return s.saveHost(op.Host)
43	}
44	
45	func (s *Service) prepareFirewall(ctx context.Context, op *operation) error {
46		if op.Request.Provider == "oracle" {
47			return nil
48		}
49		if s.options.ReadOnly {
50			return fmt.Errorf("firewall changes are disabled in read-only mode")
51		}
52		if op.PendingResourceKind != "" {
53			return fmt.Errorf("firewall create outcome is unconfirmed; run vps resume %s", op.Request.ID)
54		}
55		if op.Request.FirewallID != "" {
56			if !firewallOwned(op.Host, op.Request.FirewallID) {
57				addFirewallResource(&op.Host, "firewall", op.Request.FirewallID, false)
58				return s.persistFirewall(op)
59			}
60			if op.Request.Provider == "vultr" {
61				return s.ensureVultrFirewallRules(ctx, op)
62			}
63			return nil
64		}
65		if op.Request.Provider == "digitalocean" {
66			found := false
67			for _, r := range op.Host.Resources {
68				found = found || r.Kind == "cloud-tag" && r.ID == op.ID && r.Owned
69			}
70			if !found {
71				op.State, op.PendingResourceKind = "firewall", "firewall-tag"
72				if err := s.persistFirewall(op); err != nil {
73					return err
74				}
75				value, err := s.call(ctx, op.Request, "compute", "tag", "create", op.ID)
76				if err != nil {
77					return fmt.Errorf("tag create outcome is unconfirmed; run vps resume %s: %w", op.Request.ID, err)
78				}
79				tag, err := one(value, "tag", "tags")
80				if err != nil || str(tag["name"]) != op.ID {
81					return fmt.Errorf("tag create response does not confirm the operation name; run vps resume %s", op.Request.ID)
82				}
83				addFirewallResource(&op.Host, "cloud-tag", op.ID, true)
84				op.PendingResourceKind = ""
85				if err = s.persistFirewall(op); err != nil {
86					return err
87				}
88			}
89		}
90		args, err := firewallCreateArgs(*op)
91		if err != nil {
92			return err
93		}
94		op.State, op.PendingResourceKind = "firewall", "firewall"
95		if err = s.persistFirewall(op); err != nil {
96			return err
97		}
98		value, err := s.call(ctx, op.Request, args...)
99		if err != nil {
100			return fmt.Errorf("firewall create outcome is unconfirmed; run vps resume %s: %w", op.Request.ID, err)
101		}
102		firewall, err := one(value, "firewall", "firewall_group", "firewalls", "data")
103		if err != nil {
104			return err
105		}
106		id := str(firewall["id"])
107		if id == "" {
108			return fmt.Errorf("firewall response lacks its ID; run vps resume %s", op.Request.ID)
109		}
110		addFirewallResource(&op.Host, "firewall", id, true)
111		op.Request.FirewallID = id
112		op.PendingResourceKind = ""
113		if err = s.persistFirewall(op); err != nil {
114			return err
115		}
116		if op.Request.Provider == "vultr" {
117			return s.ensureVultrFirewallRules(ctx, op)
118		}
119		return nil
120	}
121	
122	func firewallCreateArgs(op operation) ([]string, error) {
123		ip, cidr, err := net.ParseCIDR(op.Request.SSHCIDR)
124		if err != nil {
125			return nil, fmt.Errorf("SSH firewall source must be a CIDR")
126		}
127		source := cidr.String()
128		switch op.Request.Provider {
129		case "digitalocean":
130			inbound := "protocol:tcp,ports:22,address:" + source + " protocol:tcp,ports:80,address:0.0.0.0/0,address:::/0 protocol:tcp,ports:443,address:0.0.0.0/0,address:::/0 protocol:udp,ports:443,address:0.0.0.0/0,address:::/0"
131			outbound := "protocol:icmp,address:0.0.0.0/0,address:::/0 protocol:tcp,ports:all,address:0.0.0.0/0,address:::/0 protocol:udp,ports:all,address:0.0.0.0/0,address:::/0"
132			return []string{"compute", "firewall", "create", "--name", op.ID, "--tag-names", op.ID, "--inbound-rules", inbound, "--outbound-rules", outbound}, nil
133		case "vultr":
134			return []string{"firewall", "group", "create", "--description", op.ID}, nil
135		case "linode":
136			family := "ipv4"
137			if ip.To4() == nil {
138				family = "ipv6"
139			}
140			public := map[string][]string{"ipv4": {"0.0.0.0/0"}, "ipv6": {"::/0"}}
141			rules := []any{map[string]any{"label": "ssh", "action": "ACCEPT", "protocol": "TCP", "ports": "22", "addresses": map[string][]string{family: {source}}}, map[string]any{"label": "acme", "action": "ACCEPT", "protocol": "TCP", "ports": "80", "addresses": public}, map[string]any{"label": "proxy-tcp", "action": "ACCEPT", "protocol": "TCP", "ports": "443", "addresses": public}, map[string]any{"label": "proxy-udp", "action": "ACCEPT", "protocol": "UDP", "ports": "443", "addresses": public}}
142			return []string{"firewalls", "create", "--label", op.ID, "--rules.inbound_policy", "DROP", "--rules.outbound_policy", "ACCEPT", "--rules.inbound", jsonValue(rules)}, nil
143		default:
144			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provider has no managed firewall adapter")
145		}
146	}
147	
148	type firewallRule struct {
149		Protocol, Port, Subnet string
150		Size                   int
151		Family                 string
152	}
153	
154	func desiredVultrFirewallRules(cidr string) ([]firewallRule, error) {
155		ip, network, err := net.ParseCIDR(cidr)
156		if err != nil {
157			return nil, err
158		}
159		ones, _ := network.Mask.Size()
160		family := "v4"
161		if ip.To4() == nil {
162			family = "v6"
163		}
164		rules := []firewallRule{{"tcp", "22", network.IP.String(), ones, family}}
165		for _, family := range []string{"v4", "v6"} {
166			subnet := "0.0.0.0"
167			if family == "v6" {
168				subnet = "::"
169			}
170			for _, port := range []string{"80", "443"} {
171				rules = append(rules, firewallRule{"tcp", port, subnet, 0, family})
172			}
173			rules = append(rules, firewallRule{"udp", "443", subnet, 0, family})
174		}
175		return rules, nil
176	}
177	
178	func ruleMatches(rule map[string]any, want firewallRule) bool {
179		return strings.EqualFold(str(rule["protocol"]), want.Protocol) && str(rule["port"]) == want.Port && str(rule["ip_type"]) == want.Family && net.ParseIP(str(rule["subnet"])).Equal(net.ParseIP(want.Subnet)) && int(num(rule["subnet_size"])) == want.Size
180	}
181	
182	func (s *Service) ensureVultrFirewallRules(ctx context.Context, op *operation) error {
183		wanted, err := desiredVultrFirewallRules(op.Request.SSHCIDR)
184		if err != nil {
185			return err
186		}
187		value, err := s.vultrList(ctx, op.Request, "firewall_rules", "firewall", "rule", "list", op.Request.FirewallID)
188		if err != nil {
189			return err
190		}
191		existing, err := strictResourceRows(value, "firewall_rules", "protocol")
192		if err != nil {
193			return err
194		}
195		for _, rule := range wanted {
196			found := false
197			for _, have := range existing {
198				found = found || ruleMatches(have, rule)
199			}
200			if found {
201				continue
202			}
203			// The owned group is already durable; after any timeout the next resume
204			// lists its rules before deciding whether a missing rule needs adding.
205			_, err = s.call(ctx, op.Request, "firewall", "rule", "create", op.Request.FirewallID, "--ip-type", rule.Family, "--protocol", rule.Protocol, "--subnet", rule.Subnet, "--size", strconv.Itoa(rule.Size), "--port", rule.Port, "--notes", op.ID)
206			if err != nil {
207				return fmt.Errorf("owned firewall rule result unconfirmed; resume reconciles rules before retrying: %w", err)
208			}
209		}
210		return nil
211	}
212	
213	func (s *Service) attachFirewall(ctx context.Context, op *operation) error {
214		if op.Request.Provider != "digitalocean" || op.Request.FirewallID == "" {
215			return nil
216		}
217		if firewallOwned(op.Host, op.Request.FirewallID) {
218			return nil
219		} // Already attached by unique operation tag, including future Droplets.
220		if op.Host.ResourceID == "" {
221			return fmt.Errorf("cannot attach firewall without saved instance ID")
222		}
223		_, err := s.call(ctx, op.Request, "compute", "firewall", "add-droplets", op.Request.FirewallID, "--droplet-ids", op.Host.ResourceID)
224		if err != nil {
225			return fmt.Errorf("existing firewall attachment is unconfirmed; VM remains saved for resume: %w", err)
226		}
227		return nil
228	}
229	
230	func (s *Service) listFirewalls(ctx context.Context, req CreateRequest) ([]map[string]any, error) {
231		switch req.Provider {
232		case "digitalocean":
233			value, err := s.call(ctx, req, "compute", "firewall", "list")
234			if err != nil {
235				return nil, err
236			}
237			return strictResourceRows(value, "firewalls", "id")
238		case "vultr":
239			value, err := s.vultrList(ctx, req, "firewall_groups", "firewall", "group", "list")
240			if err != nil {
241				return nil, err
242			}
243			return strictResourceRows(value, "firewall_groups", "id")
244		case "linode":
245			value, err := s.call(ctx, req, "firewalls", "list", "--all")
246			if err != nil {
247				return nil, err
248			}
249			return strictResourceRows(value, "data", "id")
250		}
251		return nil, fmt.Errorf("provider has no firewall inventory adapter")
252	}
253	
254	func firewallName(provider string, row map[string]any) string {
255		switch provider {
256		case "digitalocean":
257			return str(row["name"])
258		case "vultr":
259			return str(row["description"])
260		default:
261			return str(row["label"])
262		}
263	}
264	
265	func (s *Service) resumeFirewall(ctx context.Context, op *operation) error {
266		if op.PendingResourceKind == "firewall-tag" {
267			value, err := s.call(ctx, op.Request, "compute", "tag", "get", op.ID)
268			if err != nil {
269				return fmt.Errorf("tag creation remains unconfirmed; no create was retried: %w", err)
270			}
271			tag, err := one(value, "tag", "tags")
272			if err != nil || str(tag["name"]) != op.ID {
273				return fmt.Errorf("operation tag was not confirmed; no create was retried")
274			}
275			addFirewallResource(&op.Host, "cloud-tag", op.ID, true)
276			op.PendingResourceKind = ""
277			return s.persistFirewall(op)
278		}
279		if op.PendingResourceKind != "firewall" {
280			return fmt.Errorf("pending operation is not a firewall create")
281		}
282		rows, err := s.listFirewalls(ctx, op.Request)
283		if err != nil {
284			return err
285		}
286		var found []map[string]any
287		for _, row := range rows {
288			if firewallName(op.Request.Provider, row) == op.ID {
289				found = append(found, row)
290			}
291		}
292		if len(found) != 1 || str(found[0]["id"]) == "" {
293			return fmt.Errorf("firewall reconciliation found %d matches for operation %s; no create was retried", len(found), op.ID)
294		}
295		id := str(found[0]["id"])
296		addFirewallResource(&op.Host, "firewall", id, true)
297		op.Request.FirewallID = id
298		op.PendingResourceKind = ""
299		return s.persistFirewall(op)
300	}
301	
302	func (s *Service) cleanupFirewall(ctx context.Context, host serverstate.Host) error {
303		owned := false
304		for _, r := range host.Resources {
305			owned = owned || r.Owned && (r.Kind == "firewall" || r.Kind == "cloud-tag")
306		}
307		if !owned {
308			return nil
309		}
310		op, err := s.readOperation(host.OperationID)
311		if err != nil {
312			return err
313		}
314		op.Host = host
315		rows, err := s.listFirewalls(ctx, op.Request)
316		if err != nil {
317			return err
318		}
319		for _, resource := range append([]serverstate.Resource(nil), op.Host.Resources...) {
320			if !resource.Owned || resource.Kind != "firewall" {
321				continue
322			}
323			var current map[string]any
324			for _, row := range rows {
325				if str(row["id"]) == resource.ID {
326					current = row
327					break
328				}
329			}
330			if current != nil {
331				if firewallName(op.Request.Provider, current) != op.ID {
332					return fmt.Errorf("owned firewall identity changed; refusing to delete %s", resource.ID)
333				}
334				if len(arr(current["droplet_ids"])) > 0 || num(current["instance_count"]) > 0 {
335					return fmt.Errorf("firewall still has attached instances; wait for VM deletion before cleanup")
336				}
337				if op.Request.Provider == "linode" {
338					devices, e := s.call(ctx, op.Request, "firewalls", "devices-list", resource.ID, "--all")
339					if e != nil {
340						return e
341					}
342					deviceRows, e := strictResourceRows(devices, "data", "id")
343					if e != nil {
344						return e
345					}
346					if len(deviceRows) > 0 {
347						return fmt.Errorf("firewall still has attached devices; wait for VM deletion before cleanup")
348					}
349				}
350				var args []string
351				switch op.Request.Provider {
352				case "digitalocean":
353					args = []string{"compute", "firewall", "delete", resource.ID, "--force"}
354				case "vultr":
355					args = []string{"firewall", "group", "delete", resource.ID}
356				case "linode":
357					args = []string{"firewalls", "delete", resource.ID}
358				}
359				if _, err = s.call(ctx, op.Request, args...); err != nil {
360					return fmt.Errorf("firewall deletion unconfirmed; retry cleanup after inspecting provider state: %w", err)
361				}
362			}
363			removeFirewallResource(&op.Host, resource.Kind, resource.ID)
364			if err = s.persistFirewall(&op); err != nil {
365				return err
366			}
367		}
368		for _, resource := range append([]serverstate.Resource(nil), op.Host.Resources...) {
369			if !resource.Owned || resource.Kind != "cloud-tag" {
370				continue
371			}
372			value, err := s.call(ctx, op.Request, "compute", "tag", "list")
373			if err != nil {
374				return fmt.Errorf("cannot confirm tag is unused before cleanup: %w", err)
375			}
376			if resource.ID != op.ID {
377				return fmt.Errorf("operation tag identity changed")
378			}
379			var tag map[string]any
380			tags, err := strictResourceRows(value, "tags", "name")
381			if err != nil {
382				return err
383			}
384			for _, row := range tags {
385				if str(row["name"]) == resource.ID {
386					tag = row
387					break
388				}
389			}
390			if tag != nil {
391				count, present := resourceCount(obj(tag["resources"]))
392				if !present {
393					return fmt.Errorf("tag resource usage is missing; cannot confirm safe cleanup")
394				}
395				if count > 0 {
396					return fmt.Errorf("operation tag is still attached to resources; refusing to delete it")
397				}
398				if _, err = s.call(ctx, op.Request, "compute", "tag", "delete", resource.ID, "--force"); err != nil {
399					return fmt.Errorf("tag delete outcome is unconfirmed: %w", err)
400				}
401			}
402			removeFirewallResource(&op.Host, resource.Kind, resource.ID)
403			if err = s.persistFirewall(&op); err != nil {
404				return err
405			}
406		}
407		return nil
408	}
409	
410	func removeFirewallResource(host *serverstate.Host, kind, id string) {
411		out := host.Resources[:0]
412		for _, r := range host.Resources {
413			if r.Kind != kind || r.ID != id {
414				out = append(out, r)
415			}
416		}
417		host.Resources = out
418	}
419	func resourceCount(value map[string]any) (float64, bool) {
420		var count float64
421		found := false
422		for key, v := range value {
423			if key == "count" {
424				n, ok := v.(float64)
425				if !ok || n < 0 {
426					return 0, false
427				}
428				count += n
429				found = true
430			} else if nested := obj(v); nested != nil {
431				n, present := resourceCount(nested)
432				count += n
433				found = found || present
434			}
435		}
436		return count, found
437	}
438	
439	// A missing/malformed list is not proof that an owned resource disappeared.
440	// Retain IDs until the provider supplies a complete, correctly shaped inventory.
441	func strictResourceRows(value any, key, identity string) ([]map[string]any, error) {
442		list, ok := value.([]any)
443		if !ok {
444			list, ok = obj(value)[key].([]any)
445		}
446		if !ok {
447			return nil, fmt.Errorf("provider %s inventory is incomplete; resource absence cannot be confirmed", key)
448		}
449		rows := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(list))
450		for _, item := range list {
451			row := obj(item)
452			if row == nil || str(row[identity]) == "" {
453				return nil, fmt.Errorf("provider %s inventory contains an incomplete resource", key)
454			}
455			rows = append(rows, row)
456		}
457		return rows, nil
458	}

45	func (a azureAdapter) sizes(ctx context.Context, r CreateRequest) ([]azureSize, error) {
46		if r.Region == "" {
47			return nil, fmt.Errorf("Azure size discovery requires --region")
48		}
49		v, err := a.call(ctx, r, "vm", "list-skus", "--location", r.Region, "--resource-type", "virtualMachines", "--all")
50		if err != nil {
51			return nil, err
52		}
53		rows, err := strictItems(v)
54		if err != nil {
55			return nil, err
56		}
57		var out []azureSize
58		for _, m := range rows {
59			if str(m["resourceType"]) != "virtualMachines" {
60				continue
61			}
62			x := azureSize{name: str(m["name"])}
63			if !contains(m["locations"], r.Region) {
64				continue
65			}
66			caps := map[string]string{}
67			for _, cv := range arr(m["capabilities"]) {
68				c := obj(cv)
69				caps[str(c["name"])] = str(c["value"])
70			}
71			mem, _ := strconv.ParseFloat(caps["MemoryGB"], 64)
72			x.memory = int(mem * 1024)
73			x.cpus, _ = strconv.Atoi(caps["vCPUs"])
74			switch strings.ToLower(caps["CpuArchitectureType"]) {
75			case "arm64":
76				x.arch = "arm64"
77			case "x64", "x86_64", "amd64":
78				x.arch = "amd64"
79			default:
80				continue
81			}
82			if x.memory < 1024 || x.cpus < 1 || !strings.Contains(caps["HyperVGenerations"], "V2") {
83				continue
84			}
85			for _, li := range arr(m["locationInfo"]) {
86				l := obj(li)
87				if str(l["location"]) == r.Region {
88					for _, z := range arr(l["zones"]) {
89						x.zones = append(x.zones, str(z))
90					}
91				}
92			}
93			blocked := false
94			for _, rv := range arr(m["restrictions"]) {
95				rr := obj(rv)
96				ri := obj(rr["restrictionInfo"])
97				if str(rr["type"]) == "Location" && (len(arr(rr["values"])) == 0 || contains(rr["values"], r.Region)) {
98					blocked = true
99				}
100				if r.AvailabilityZone != "" && str(rr["type"]) == "Zone" && (len(arr(ri["locations"])) == 0 || contains(ri["locations"], r.Region)) && contains(ri["zones"], r.AvailabilityZone) {
101					blocked = true
102				}
103			}
104			if blocked || (r.AvailabilityZone != "" && !azureContains(x.zones, r.AvailabilityZone)) {
105				continue
106			}
107			if r.Architecture != "" && r.Architecture != "auto" && r.Architecture != x.arch {
108				continue
109			}
110			out = append(out, x)
111		}
112		return out, nil
113	}
114	func azureContains(a []string, v string) bool {

116			if s == v {
117				return true
118			}
119		}
120		return false

122	func azureRecommended(s string) bool {
123		return azureContains([]string{"Standard_B1s", "Standard_B2ats_v2", "Standard_B2pts_v2", "Standard_B2ts_v2"}, s)

126	func (a azureAdapter) Resolve(ctx context.Context, r CreateRequest) (CreateRequest, Quote, error) {
127		if r.SubscriptionID == "" {
128			return r, Quote{}, fmt.Errorf("Azure requires --subscription")
129		}
130		if r.Profile != "" {
131			return r, Quote{}, fmt.Errorf("Azure uses --subscription, not --profile")
132		}
133		if r.FirewallID != "" || r.SubnetID != "" {
134			return r, Quote{}, fmt.Errorf("Azure creation uses a dedicated owned network; register an existing VM to use existing networking")
135		}
136		if r.DiskGB == 0 {
137			r.DiskGB = 32
138		}
139		if _, err := azureDiskTier(r.DiskGB); err != nil {
140			return r, Quote{}, err
141		}
142		sizes, err := a.sizes(ctx, r)
143		if err != nil {
144			return r, Quote{}, err
145		}
146		var selected *azureSize
147		var quote Quote
148		for _, size := range sizes {
149			if r.Plan != "" && size.name != r.Plan {
150				continue
151			}
152			if r.Plan == "" && !azureRecommended(size.name) {
153				continue
154			}
155			q, e := a.quoteSize(ctx, r, size)
156			if e != nil {
157				if r.Plan != "" {
158					return r, q, e
159				}
160				continue
161			}
162			if selected == nil || q.MonthlyUSD < quote.MonthlyUSD || (q.MonthlyUSD == quote.MonthlyUSD && size.name < selected.name) {
163				x := size
164				selected = &x
165				quote = q
166			}
167		}
168		if selected == nil {
169			return r, Quote{}, fmt.Errorf("no fully priced compatible Azure size is available in %s; inspect subscription quota, SKU restrictions, architecture and zone", r.Region)
170		}
171		r.Plan = selected.name
172		r.Architecture = selected.arch
173		if r.Image == "" {
174			choices, e := a.images(ctx, r)
175			if e != nil {
176				return r, quote, e
177			}
178			r.Image = choices[len(choices)-1].ID
179		}
180		fields := strings.Split(r.Image, ":")
181		sku := "server"
182		if r.Architecture == "arm64" {
183			sku = "server-arm64"
184		}
185		if len(fields) != 4 || !strings.EqualFold(fields[0], "Canonical") || fields[1] != "ubuntu-24_04-lts" || fields[2] != sku || fields[3] == "latest" || fields[3] == "" {
186			return r, quote, fmt.Errorf("Azure requires a pinned Canonical Ubuntu 24.04 %s image URN", r.Architecture)
187		}
188		v, e := a.call(ctx, r, "vm", "image", "show", "--location", r.Region, "--urn", r.Image)
189		if e != nil {
190			return r, quote, e
191		}
192		m := obj(v)
193		arch := strings.ToLower(str(m["architecture"]))
194		if (r.Architecture == "arm64" && arch != "arm64") || (r.Architecture == "amd64" && arch != "x64") || str(obj(m["osDiskImage"])["operatingSystem"]) != "Linux" || str(m["hyperVGeneration"]) != "V2" {
195			return r, quote, fmt.Errorf("Azure image architecture, operating system or generation differs from the reviewed size")
196		}
197		if version := str(m["name"]); version != "" && version != fields[3] {
198			return r, quote, fmt.Errorf("Azure image version changed")
199		}
200		r.ImageVersion = fields[3]
201		return r, quote, nil
202	}
203	func (a azureAdapter) images(ctx context.Context, r CreateRequest) ([]Choice, error) {
204		arch := r.Architecture
205		if arch == "" || arch == "auto" {
206			if r.Plan == "" {
207				return nil, fmt.Errorf("select an Azure plan before image discovery")
208			}
209			ss, e := a.sizes(ctx, r)
210			if e != nil {
211				return nil, e
212			}
213			for _, s := range ss {
214				if s.name == r.Plan {
215					arch = s.arch
216				}
217			}
218		}
219		sku := "server"
220		if arch == "arm64" {
221			sku = "server-arm64"
222		} else if arch != "amd64" {
223			return nil, fmt.Errorf("Azure image architecture is not resolved")
224		}
225		v, e := a.call(ctx, r, "vm", "image", "list", "--location", r.Region, "--publisher", "Canonical", "--offer", "ubuntu-24_04-lts", "--sku", sku, "--all")
226		if e != nil {
227			return nil, e
228		}
229		rows, e := strictItems(v)
230		if e != nil {
231			return nil, e
232		}
233		var out []Choice
234		for _, m := range rows {
235			if !strings.EqualFold(str(m["publisher"]), "Canonical") || str(m["offer"]) != "ubuntu-24_04-lts" || str(m["sku"]) != sku {
236				continue
237			}
238			ver := str(m["version"])
239			if ver == "" || ver == "latest" {
240				continue
241			}
242			out = append(out, Choice{ID: "Canonical:ubuntu-24_04-lts:" + sku + ":" + ver, Label: "Ubuntu 24.04 " + arch + " · " + ver})
243		}
244		sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return azureVersionLess(out[i].ID, out[j].ID) })
245		if len(out) == 0 {
246			return nil, fmt.Errorf("no pinned Canonical Ubuntu 24.04 image available")
247		}
248		return out, nil
249	}
250	func azureVersionLess(a, b string) bool {
251		aa := strings.Split(a[strings.LastIndex(a, ":")+1:], ".")
252		bb := strings.Split(b[strings.LastIndex(b, ":")+1:], ".")
253		for i := 0; i < len(aa) && i < len(bb); i++ {
254			x, _ := strconv.Atoi(aa[i])
255			y, _ := strconv.Atoi(bb[i])
256			if x != y {
257				return x < y
258			}
259		}
260		return a < b
261	}
262	func (a azureAdapter) Discover(ctx context.Context, r CreateRequest, kind string) ([]Choice, error) {
263		var out []Choice
264		switch kind {
265		case "subscriptions":
266			v, e := a.call(ctx, r, "account", "list")
267			if e != nil {
268				return nil, e
269			}
270			rows, e := strictItems(v)
271			if e != nil {
272				return nil, e
273			}
274			for _, m := range rows {
275				if str(m["environmentName"]) == "AzureCloud" && str(m["state"]) == "Enabled" {
276					out = append(out, Choice{ID: str(m["id"]), Label: str(m["name"]) + " · " + str(m["id"])})
277				}
278			}
279		case "regions":
280			v, e := a.call(ctx, r, "account", "list-locations")
281			if e != nil {
282				return nil, e
283			}
284			rows, e := strictItems(v)
285			if e != nil {
286				return nil, e
287			}
288			for _, m := range rows {
289				if str(obj(m["metadata"])["regionType"]) != "Physical" {
290					continue
291				}
292				out = append(out, Choice{ID: str(m["name"]), Label: str(m["displayName"])})
293			}
294		case "images":
295			return a.images(ctx, r)
296		case "plans", "zones":
297			ss, e := a.sizes(ctx, r)
298			if e != nil {
299				return nil, e
300			}
301			if r.DiskGB == 0 {
302				r.DiskGB = 32
303			}
304			seen := map[string]bool{}
305			for _, s := range ss {
306				if kind == "zones" {
307					if r.Plan != "" && s.name != r.Plan {
308						continue
309					}
310					for _, z := range s.zones {
311						if !seen[z] {
312							seen[z] = true
313							out = append(out, Choice{ID: z, Label: r.Region + " zone " + z})
314						}
315					}
316					continue
317				}
318				if !azureRecommended(s.name) {
319					continue
320				}
321				q, e := a.quoteSize(ctx, r, s)
322				if e != nil {
323					continue
324				}
325				out = append(out, Choice{ID: s.name, Label: fmt.Sprintf("%s · %s · %d MiB · $%.2f/mo including disk/IPv4", s.name, s.arch, s.memory, q.MonthlyUSD)})
326			}
327		default:
328			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported Azure discovery %q", kind)
329		}
330		sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].Label < out[j].Label })
331		if len(out) == 0 {
332			return nil, fmt.Errorf("Azure returned no suitable %s", kind)
333		}
334		return out, nil
335	}

58		add := func(kind, suffix string, cli []string, args []string, parent string) {
59			flags := append([]string{}, group...)
60			flags = append(flags, "--name", name+suffix)
61			flags = append(flags, args...)
62			specs = append(specs, azureSpec{kind: kind, name: name + suffix, cli: cli, args: flags, parent: parent})
63		}
64		add("azure-vnet", "-vnet", []string{"network", "vnet"}, append(append([]string{}, location...), "--address-prefixes", "10.208.0.0/16", "--tags", tag), "")
65		add("azure-nsg", "-nsg", []string{"network", "nsg"}, append(append([]string{}, location...), "--tags", tag), "")
66		for i, rule := range []struct {
67			name, protocol, source string
68			ports                  []string
69		}{{"ssh", "Tcp", r.SSHCIDR, []string{"22"}}, {"web", "Tcp", "0.0.0.0/0", []string{"80", "443"}}, {"udp", "Udp", "0.0.0.0/0", []string{"443"}}} {
70			args := append([]string{}, group...)
71			args = append(args, "--nsg-name", name+"-nsg", "--name", rule.name, "--priority", strconv.Itoa(100+i), "--direction", "Inbound", "--access", "Allow", "--protocol", rule.protocol, "--source-address-prefixes", rule.source, "--source-port-ranges", "*", "--destination-address-prefixes", "*", "--destination-port-ranges")
72			args = append(args, rule.ports...)
73			specs = append(specs, azureSpec{kind: "azure-nsg-" + rule.name, name: rule.name, cli: []string{"network", "nsg", "rule"}, args: args, parent: "azure-nsg"})
74		}
75		specs = append(specs, azureSpec{kind: "azure-subnet", name: "default", cli: []string{"network", "vnet", "subnet"}, parent: "azure-vnet", args: append(append([]string{}, group...), "--vnet-name", name+"-vnet", "--name", "default", "--address-prefixes", "10.208.1.0/24", "--network-security-group", azureID(op, "azure-nsg"), "--default-outbound-access", "false")})
76		ipargs := append(append([]string{}, location...), "--sku", "Standard", "--allocation-method", "Static", "--version", "IPv4", "--tags", tag)
77		if r.AvailabilityZone != "" {
78			ipargs = append(ipargs, "--zone", r.AvailabilityZone)
79		}
80		add("azure-ip", "-ip", []string{"network", "public-ip"}, ipargs, "")
81		add("azure-nic", "-nic", []string{"network", "nic"}, append(append([]string{}, location...), "--subnet", azureID(op, "azure-subnet"), "--network-security-group", azureID(op, "azure-nsg"), "--public-ip-address", azureID(op, "azure-ip"), "--tags", tag), "")
82		for i := range specs {
83			specs[i].id = azureID(op, specs[i].kind)

For local proxy inspection, `proxy status` is the closest entry point, while `diagnostics network` adds passive host evidence. 26	// DefaultPath follows XDG on macOS and Linux, ignoring relative XDG paths.
27	func DefaultPath() (string, error) {
28		base := os.Getenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME")
29		if !filepath.IsAbs(base) {
30			home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
31			if err != nil || !filepath.IsAbs(home) {
32				return "", errors.New("cannot determine home directory for lazyclash configuration")
33			}
34			base = filepath.Join(home, ".config")

39	// Load never creates directories. Explicitly selected missing files are errors.
40	func Load(path string, explicit bool) (Config, error) {
41		abs, err := filepath.Abs(path)
42		if err != nil {
43			return Config{}, err
44		}
45		data, err := os.ReadFile(abs)
46		if err != nil {
47			if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) && !explicit {
48				return Config{loaded: true, loadedPath: abs}, nil
49			}
50			return Config{}, fmt.Errorf("read configuration: %w", err)
51		}
52		var cfg Config
53		if err := toml.Unmarshal(data, &cfg); err != nil {
54			return Config{}, errors.New("invalid TOML configuration; check syntax and field types")
55		}
56		if err := Validate(cfg); err != nil {
57			return Config{}, err
58		}
59		cfg.loaded, cfg.loadedPath, cfg.original, cfg.existed = true, abs, data, true
60		return cfg, nil
61	}

2	// routing/DNS exclusions. It never enables a VPN, edits routes or stops services.

84	func Inspect(ctx context.Context, sshHost string) (Report, error) {

87	func InspectWithOptions(ctx context.Context, sshHost string, opts InspectOptions) (Report, error) {
88		if opts.Execute == nil {
89			opts.Execute = connection.ExecutePython
90		}
91		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 40*time.Second)
92		defer cancel()
93		data, err := opts.Execute(ctx, sshHost, inspectScript, []byte("{}"), 2<<20)
94		if err != nil {
95			return Report{}, err
96		}
97		var report Report
98		if json.Unmarshal(data, &report) != nil || report.Protocol != 1 {
99			return Report{}, errors.New("network inventory returned an unsupported response")
100		}
101		report.Scope = "local host"
102		if sshHost != "" {
103			report.Scope = "SSH host " + sshHost
104		}
105		return Analyze(report), nil

107	
108	// WithCoreTUN adds a separately observed controller result. A process name or an
109	// utun interface alone cannot establish that Mihomo owns the active TUN.
110	func WithCoreTUN(report Report, enabled bool) Report {
111		report.ExistingTUN, report.CoreTUNKnown = enabled, true
112		return Analyze(report)
113	}
114	func WithCoreTUNDevice(report Report, enabled bool, device string) Report {
115		report.CoreTUNDevice = device
116		return WithCoreTUN(report, enabled)
117	}
118	
119	func Analyze(report Report) Report {
120		report.Conflicts = nil
121		report.ExcludedRoutes = nil
122		report.DNSPolicies = map[string][]string{}
123		report.FakeIPFilter = nil
124		add := func(code, level, confidence, message string, evidence ...string) {
125			report.Conflicts = append(report.Conflicts, Finding{code, level, confidence, message, evidence})
126		}
127		excluded := map[string]bool{}
128		addPrefix := func(raw string) {
129			prefix, err := netip.ParsePrefix(raw)
130			if err != nil {
131				if ip, e := netip.ParseAddr(raw); e == nil {
132					prefix = netip.PrefixFrom(ip, ip.BitLen())
133				} else {
134					return
135				}
136			}
137			if prefix.Bits() > 0 {
138				excluded[prefix.Masked().String()] = true
139			}
140		}
141		for _, p := range []string{"127.0.0.0/8", "::1/128"} {
142			addPrefix(p)
143		}
144		if report.ManagementAddress != "" {
145			addPrefix(report.ManagementAddress)
146		}
147		interfaces := map[string]Interface{}
148		for _, iface := range report.Interfaces {
149			interfaces[iface.Name] = iface
150		}
151		if report.Tailscale.Running {
152			addPrefix("100.64.0.0/10")
153			addPrefix("fd7a:115c:a1e0::/48")
154			if suffix := domain(report.Tailscale.Suffix); suffix != "" {
155				report.DNSPolicies["+."+suffix] = []string{"100.100.100.100"}
156				report.FakeIPFilter = append(report.FakeIPFilter, "+."+suffix)
157			}
158			add("tailscale-split", "information", "confirmed", "Review tailnet and accepted subnet exclusions together with MagicDNS settings.")
159		}
160		if report.Tailscale.ExitNode {
161			add("tailscale-exit-node", "conflict", "confirmed", "A Tailscale exit node owns default routing; choose one full-tunnel owner before enabling Mihomo TUN.")
162		}
163		defaultVPN := map[string][]string{}
164		for _, route := range report.Routes {
165			iface := interfaces[route.Interface]
166			vpn := tunnelInterface(route.Interface, iface.Kind)
167			prefix, err := netip.ParsePrefix(route.Destination)
168			full := route.Destination == "default" || (err == nil && prefix.Bits() <= 1)
169			if full && vpn && !route.Scoped {
170				defaultVPN[route.Interface] = append(defaultVPN[route.Interface], route.Destination)
171			}
172			if err != nil || full {
173				continue
174			}
175			// Exclude actual connected private routes and accepted routes through VPNs,
176			// not arbitrary advertised peer prefixes or the whole default route.
177			if (vpn && route.Interface != report.CoreTUNDevice && !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(route.Interface), "mihomo")) || (!vpn && prefix.Addr().IsPrivate() && route.Gateway == "") {
178				addPrefix(prefix.String())
179			}
180			if route.Table == "2022" && !report.CoreTUNKnown {
181				add("possible-mihomo-table", "warning", "probable", "Routing table 2022 is present; inspect the existing TUN owner before setup.", route.Interface)
182			}
183		}
184		for iface, routes := range defaultVPN {
185			// One /1 is not evidence for both halves, but is still overlapping global
186			// routing that must be resolved before installing another default route.
187			add("vpn-default-route", "conflict", "confirmed", "An existing tunnel has default or broad /1 routes; choose its routing owner before enabling another TUN.", append([]string{iface}, routes...)...)
188		}
189		for _, resolver := range report.Resolvers {
190			var servers []string
191			for _, server := range resolver.Servers {
192				ip, err := netip.ParseAddr(strings.Split(server, "%")[0])
193				if err != nil {
194					continue
195				}
196				servers = append(servers, server)
197				if ip.IsPrivate() || isTailnetIP(ip) {
198					addPrefix(ip.String())
199				}
200			}
201			for _, suffix := range resolver.Domains {
202				suffix = strings.TrimPrefix(suffix, "~")
203				if suffix == "." {
204					if tunnelInterface(resolver.Interface, interfaces[resolver.Interface].Kind) {
205						add("vpn-default-dns", "warning", "confirmed", "A VPN resolver handles all DNS domains; inspect resolver precedence before enabling DNS interception.", resolver.Interface)
206					}
207					continue
208				}
209				if suffix = domain(suffix); suffix != "" && len(servers) > 0 {
210					key := "+." + suffix
211					report.DNSPolicies[key] = appendUnique(report.DNSPolicies[key], servers...)
212					report.FakeIPFilter = appendUnique(report.FakeIPFilter, key)
213				}
214			}
215		}
216		if report.ExistingTUN {
217			add("existing-core-tun", "conflict", "confirmed", "The observed core already owns TUN; configure that owner instead of starting a second TUN.")
218		}
219		for _, process := range report.Processes {
220			name := strings.ToLower(process)
221			if strings.Contains(name, "safeconnect") || strings.Contains(name, "openvpn") || strings.Contains(name, "openconnect") || strings.Contains(name, "vpnagent") || strings.Contains(name, "forti") || strings.Contains(name, "globalprotect") || strings.Contains(name, "charon") {
222				add("vpn-client-present", "warning", "probable", "A VPN client is running; process presence alone does not prove interception or compatibility.", process)
223			}
224		}
225		for _, capability := range report.Capabilities {
226			if !capability.Available {
227				add("inventory-unavailable", "warning", "unknown", "Some network evidence is unavailable; an empty result is not proof of no conflict.", capability.Name, capability.Detail)
228			}
229		}
230		for p := range excluded {
231			prefix, _ := netip.ParsePrefix(p)
232			covered := false
233			for other := range excluded {
234				parent, _ := netip.ParsePrefix(other)
235				if parent.Bits() < prefix.Bits() && parent.Contains(prefix.Addr()) {
236					covered = true
237					break
238				}
239			}
240			if !covered {
241				report.ExcludedRoutes = append(report.ExcludedRoutes, p)
242			}
243		}
244		sort.Strings(report.ExcludedRoutes)
245		sort.Strings(report.FakeIPFilter)
246		sort.SliceStable(report.Conflicts, func(i, j int) bool {
247			a, b := report.Conflicts[i], report.Conflicts[j]
248			return a.Code+strings.Join(a.Evidence, ",") < b.Code+strings.Join(b.Evidence, ",")
249		})
250		return report
251	}

255		DNSPolicies  map[string][]string `json:"dns_policies"`
256		FakeIPFilter []string            `json:"fake_ip_filter"`
257		DirectRules  []string            `json:"direct_rules"`
258		Findings     []Finding           `json:"findings"`
259		Blocked      bool                `json:"blocked"`
260	}

17	
18	func ValidateEndpoint(value string) error {
19		return config.ValidateProbe(config.Target{ProbeProxy: value})
20	}
21	
22	func Resolve(ctx context.Context, cfg config.Config, request Request, opts Options) (Plan, error) {
23		getenv := opts.Getenv
24		if getenv == nil {
25			getenv = os.Getenv
26		}
27		if request.Endpoint != "" {
28			if request.TargetID != "" {
29				return Plan{}, errors.New("use either --endpoint or --target")
30			}
31			return explicitPlan(request.Endpoint, request.SocksEndpoint, "explicit endpoint")
32		}
33		if request.SocksEndpoint != "" {
34			return Plan{}, errors.New("--socks-endpoint requires --endpoint")
35		}
36		if request.TargetID != "" {
37			for _, target := range cfg.Targets {
38				if target.ID == request.TargetID {
39					return resolveTarget(ctx, target, opts)
40				}
41			}
42			return Plan{}, errors.New("proxy target is not registered; use targets list")
43		}
44		if value := getenv("LOCAL_PROXY_URL"); value != "" {
45			return explicitPlan(value, getenv("LOCAL_PROXY_SOCKS_URL"), "LOCAL_PROXY_URL")
46		}
47		var local []config.Target
48		for _, target := range cfg.Targets {
49			if IsLocalTarget(target) {
50				local = append(local, target)
51			}
52		}
53		for _, target := range local {
54			if target.ID == cfg.DefaultTarget {
55				return resolveTarget(ctx, target, opts)
56			}
57		}
58		if len(local) == 0 {
59			discover := opts.Discover
60			if discover == nil {
61				discover = connection.Discover
62			}
63			var err error
64			local, err = discover(ctx, "")
65			if err != nil {
66				return Plan{}, err
67			}
68		}
69		if len(local) == 0 {
70			return Plan{}, ErrNoProxyConfigured
71		}
72		if len(local) > 1 {
73			return Plan{}, &AmbiguousError{Targets: local}
74		}
75		return resolveTarget(ctx, local[0], opts)
76	}
77	
78	func IsLocalTarget(target config.Target) bool {
79		if target.SSHHost != "" {
80			return false
81		}
82		u, err := url.Parse(target.Controller)
83		if err != nil {
84			return false
85		}
86		return u.Scheme == "unix" || loopback(u.Hostname())
87	}
88	func loopback(host string) bool {
89		ip := net.ParseIP(host)
90		return strings.EqualFold(host, "localhost") || (ip != nil && ip.IsLoopback())
91	}
92	
93	func explicitPlan(endpoint, socks, source string) (Plan, error) {
94		if endpoint == "" {
95			return Plan{}, errors.New("a data proxy endpoint is required")
96		}
97		if err := ValidateEndpoint(endpoint); err != nil {
98			return Plan{}, err
99		}
100		if socks != "" {
101			if err := ValidateEndpoint(socks); err != nil {
102				return Plan{}, err
103			}
104			u, _ := url.Parse(socks)
105			if u.Scheme != "socks5" && u.Scheme != "socks5h" {
106				return Plan{}, errors.New("SOCKS endpoint must use socks5 or socks5h")
107			}
108		} else {
109			socks = endpoint
110		}
111		return Plan{HTTP: endpoint, All: socks, Source: source}, nil
112	}
113	
114	func resolveTarget(ctx context.Context, target config.Target, opts Options) (Plan, error) {
115		var plan Plan
116		var err error
117		if target.ProbeProxy != "" {
118			plan, err = explicitPlan(target.ProbeProxy, "", "registered data proxy")
119		} else {
120			// A remote controller may be behind a reverse proxy. Its hostname is not
121			// evidence that data ports are accessible on that same host.
122			if target.SSHHost == "" && !IsLocalTarget(target) {
123				return plan, errors.New("remote target needs an explicit --probe-proxy endpoint in targets edit")
124			}
125			open := opts.Open
126			if open == nil {
127				open = connection.Open
128			}
129			queryCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 8*time.Second)
130			defer cancel()
131			client, closer, e := open(queryCtx, target, true)
132			if closer != nil {
133				defer closer.Close()
134			}
135			if client != nil {
136				defer client.Close()
137			}
138			if e != nil {
139				return plan, e
140			}
141			if client == nil {
142				return plan, errors.New("controller client unavailable")
143			}
144			runtime, e := client.Config(queryCtx)
145			if e != nil {
146				return plan, e
147			}
148			host := "127.0.0.1"
149			u, _ := url.Parse(target.Controller)
150			if u.Scheme != "unix" && u.Hostname() == "::1" {
151				host = "::1"
152			}
153			port := runtimePort(runtime["mixed-port"])
154			socks := port
155			if port == 0 {
156				port = runtimePort(runtime["port"])
157				socks = runtimePort(runtime["socks-port"])
158			}
159			if port == 0 && socks == 0 {
160				return plan, errors.New("core reports no HTTP/mixed/SOCKS port; configure --probe-proxy explicitly")
161			}
162			endpoint := ""
163			all := ""
164			if port > 0 {
165				endpoint = "http://" + net.JoinHostPort(host, strconv.Itoa(port))
166			}
167			if socks > 0 {
168				all = "socks5h://" + net.JoinHostPort(host, strconv.Itoa(socks))
169			}
170			if endpoint == "" {
171				endpoint = all
172			}
173			plan, err = explicitPlan(endpoint, all, "core runtime ports")
174		}
175		if err != nil {
176			return plan, err
177		}
178		plan.TargetID, plan.SSHHost = target.ID, target.SSHHost
179		plan.Username, plan.PasswordEnv, plan.PasswordFile, plan.CAFile = target.ProbeUsername, target.ProbePasswordEnv, target.ProbePasswordFile, target.ProbeCAFile
180		return plan, nil
181	}
182	func runtimePort(value any) int {
183		var n int
184		switch v := value.(type) {
185		case float64:
186			if v != float64(int(v)) {
187				return 0
188			}
189			n = int(v)
190		case int:
191			n = v
192		case json.Number:
193			n, _ = strconv.Atoi(string(v))
194		case string:
195			n, _ = strconv.Atoi(v)
196		}
197		if n < 1 || n > 65535 {
198			return 0
199		}
200		return n
201	}
202	
203	func (p Plan) Validate() error {
204		if _, err := explicitPlan(p.HTTP, p.socks(), p.Source); err != nil {
205			return err
206		}
207		if p.SSHHost != "" {
208			if err := config.ValidateTarget(config.Target{Controller: "http://127.0.0.1:9090", SSHHost: p.SSHHost}); err != nil {
209				return err
210			}
211		}
212		if err := config.ValidateProbe(config.Target{ProbeProxy: p.HTTP, ProbeUsername: p.Username, ProbePasswordEnv: p.PasswordEnv, ProbePasswordFile: p.PasswordFile, ProbeCAFile: p.CAFile}); err != nil {
213			return fmt.Errorf("proxy credentials: %w", err)
214		}
215		return nil
216	}
217	func (p Plan) socks() string {
218		if p.All == p.HTTP {
219			return ""
220		}
221		return p.All
222	}

417	func Status(ctx context.Context, id string, opts SessionOptions) (Session, error) {
418		dir, err := sessionDir(opts, false)
419		if err != nil {
420			return Session{}, err
421		}
422		s, err := readSession(dir, id)
423		if err != nil {
424			return s, err
425		}
426		ownerPID, ownerIdentity := sessionOwner(s)
427		identity, err := processIdentity(ownerPID)
428		if err != nil {
429			return s, err
430		}
431		if identity != ownerIdentity {
432			s.State = "orphaned"
433			return s, nil
434		}
435		if s.Socket != "" {
436			if _, err := checkMaster(ctx, s, opts); err != nil {
437				s.State = "unavailable"
438			}
439		}
440		return s, nil
441	}
442	func SessionPlan(ctx context.Context, id string, opts SessionOptions) (Plan, error) {
443		s, err := Status(ctx, id, opts)
444		if err != nil {
445			return Plan{}, err
446		}
447		if s.State != "ready" {
448			return Plan{}, errors.New("proxy session is unavailable; run proxy-on to recreate it")
449		}
450		if s.Reverse != nil {
451			return Plan{}, errors.New("reverse SSH endpoints belong on the remote host; use proxy tunnel share or proxy ssh, not a local shell session")
452		}
453		return s.Local, nil
454	}
455	
456	func Stop(ctx context.Context, id string, opts SessionOptions) error {
457		dir, err := sessionDir(opts, false)
458		if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
459			return nil
460		}
461		if err != nil {
462			return err
463		}
464		if !sessionID.MatchString(id) {
465			return errors.New("invalid session ID")
466		}
467		lock, err := lockFile(filepath.Join(dir, id+".lock"))
468		if err != nil {
469			return err
470		}
471		defer unlockFile(lock)
472		s, err := readSession(dir, id)
473		if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
474			return nil
475		}
476		if err != nil {
477			return err
478		}
479		return stopSession(ctx, dir, s, opts)
480	}
481	func stopSession(ctx context.Context, dir string, s Session, opts SessionOptions) error {
482		if s.Socket != "" {
483			identity, err := socketIdentity(s.Socket)
484			if err == nil {
485				if s.SocketIdentity == "" {
486					s.SocketIdentity = identity
487				} // pending record owns its random private directory
488				if identity != s.SocketIdentity {
489					return errors.New("session socket changed; refusing cleanup")
490				}
491				if _, err = checkMaster(ctx, s, opts); err != nil {
492					// A dead owned master can leave its socket behind. Never infer
493					// death merely from an unresponsive socket or failed ps query.
494					alive, identityErr := processIdentity(s.MasterPID)
495					if s.MasterPID == 0 || identityErr != nil || alive != "" {
496						return errors.New("cannot verify session master for cleanup; record retained")
497					}
498				} else if _, err = control(ctx, s, "exit", nil, opts); err != nil {
499					return errors.New("session shutdown uncertain; record retained")
500				}
501			} else if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
502				return err
503			} else if s.MasterPID != 0 {
504				alive, e := processIdentity(s.MasterPID)
505				if e != nil {
506					return e
507				}
508				if alive == s.MasterIdentity && alive != "" {
509					return errors.New("owned SSH master is still running but its control socket is missing; record retained")
510				}
511			}
512			// Never recursively delete: unexpected files or a replacement socket
513			// remain for inspection instead of touching another process's state.
514			if _, err := os.Lstat(s.Socket); err == nil {
515				if current, e := socketIdentity(s.Socket); e == nil && current == s.SocketIdentity {
516					_ = os.Remove(s.Socket)
517				}
518			}
519			_ = os.Remove(s.SocketDir)
520		}
521		path, _ := sessionPath(dir, s.ID)
522		return os.Remove(path)
523	}
524

527		if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
528			return []string{}, nil
529		}

83			client.Close()

86			}

19	type closerFunc func() error
20	
21	func (f closerFunc) Close() error { return f() }
22	
23	// Open never falls back to a different target. Secrets are resolved only from
24	// references on this target, and are never passed to SSH or another process.
25	func Open(ctx context.Context, target config.Target, readOnly bool) (*core.Client, io.Closer, error) {
26		if err := config.ValidateTarget(target); err != nil {
27			return nil, nil, err
28		}
29		[REDACTED:generic-credential-uri], err := resolveSecret(ctx, target)
30		if err != nil {
31			return nil, nil, err
32		}
33		opts := core.Options{Endpoint: target.Controller, Secret: [REDACTED:generic-credential-uri], CAFile: target.CAFile, ReadOnly: readOnly}
34		var closer io.Closer = closerFunc(func() error { return nil })
35		if target.SSHHost != "" {
36			u, _ := url.Parse(target.Controller)
37			if u.Scheme == "unix" {
38				return nil, nil, errors.New("remote Unix controller sockets are not supported; expose a loopback HTTP(S) controller on the SSH host")
39			}
40			tunnel, err := openTunnel(ctx, target.SSHHost, u)
41			if err != nil {
42				return nil, nil, err
43			}
44			closer = tunnel
45			opts.DialContext = func(ctx context.Context, network, address string) (net.Conn, error) {
46				return (&net.Dialer{Timeout: 10 * time.Second}).DialContext(ctx, "tcp", tunnel.address)
47			}
48		}
49		client, err := core.New(opts)
50		if err != nil {
51			_ = closer.Close()
52			return nil, nil, err
53		}
54		version, err := client.Version(ctx)
55		if err == nil {
56			if v, ok := version["version"].(string); !ok || v == "" {
57				err = &core.Error{Kind: core.KindInvalid, Operation: "identify controller"}
58			}
59		}
60		if err != nil {
61			_ = client.Close()
62			_ = closer.Close()
63			return nil, nil, err
64		}
65		transportCloser := closer
66		return client, closerFunc(func() error { _ = client.Close(); return transportCloser.Close() }), nil
67	}

69	func resolveSecret(ctx context.Context, t config.Target) (string, error) {
70		if t.SecretEnv != "" {
71			[REDACTED:generic-credential-uri], ok := os.LookupEnv(t.SecretEnv)
72			if !ok {
73				return "", fmt.Errorf("[REDACTED:generic-credential-uri] environment variable %s is not set", t.SecretEnv)
74			}
75			return cleanSecret([REDACTED:generic-credential-uri])
76		}
77		if t.SecretFile != "" {
78			data, err := readLimitedFile(t.SecretFile, 64*1024)
79			if err != nil {
80				return "", errors.New("cannot read configured local [REDACTED:generic-credential-uri] file")
81			}
82			return cleanSecret(strings.TrimRight(string(data), "\r\n"))
83		}
84		if t.SourceConfig != "" {
85			var data []byte
86			var err error
87			if t.SSHHost != "" {
88				data, err = remoteRead(ctx, t.SSHHost, t.SourceConfig)
89			} else {
90				data, err = readLimitedFile(t.SourceConfig, maxConfigBytes)
91			}
92			if err != nil {
93				if IsAuthRequired(err) {
94					return "", err
95				}
96				return "", errors.New("cannot read this target's source_config; fix its path or configure [REDACTED:generic-credential-uri]_env/[REDACTED:generic-credential-uri]_file")
97			}
98			runtime, err := parseRuntime(data)
99			if err != nil {
100				return "", errors.New("invalid YAML in this target's source_config")
101			}
102			if !runtime.matches(t.Controller) {
103				return "", errors.New("source_config controller no longer matches this target; rediscover or configure an explicit [REDACTED:generic-credential-uri] reference")
104			}
105			return cleanSecret(runtime.Secret)
106		}
107		return cleanSecret(t.Secret)
108	}
109	
110	func cleanSecret(s string) (string, error) {
111		if strings.ContainsAny(s, "\r\n\x00") {
112			return "", errors.New("controller [REDACTED:generic-credential-uri] contains invalid control characters")
113		}
114		return s, nil
115	}

117	func readLimitedFile(path string, limit int64) ([]byte, error) {
118		f, err := os.Open(path)
119		if err != nil {
120			return nil, err
121		}
122		defer f.Close()
123		info, err := f.Stat()
124		if err != nil {
125			return nil, err
126		}
127		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
128			return nil, errors.New("expected a regular file")
129		}
130		data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(f, limit+1))
131		if err != nil {
132			return nil, err
133		}
134		if int64(len(data)) > limit {
135			return nil, errors.New("file exceeds size limit")
136		}
137		return data, nil
138	}

12	var ErrPythonUnavailable = errors.New("Python 3 is unavailable on this host")
13	var ErrHelperOutputLimit = errors.New("host helper exceeded its output limit; inspect the helper before retrying")
14	var ErrHelperFailed = errors.New("host helper failed; inspect Python availability, permissions and helper prerequisites")
15	
16	// SSHTransportError classifies known transport failures without retaining raw
17	// stderr, host names or command text, any of which may contain private data.
18	type SSHTransportError struct{ Kind string }
19	
20	func (e *SSHTransportError) Error() string {
21		switch e.Kind {
22		case "timeout":
23			return "SSH connection timed out; inspect the route, proxy/TUN routing and SSH ingress firewall"
24		case "refused":
25			return "SSH connection was refused; inspect the SSH listener, selected port and firewall"
26		case "unreachable":
27			return "SSH host has no reachable network route; inspect local routing, proxy/TUN routing and the remote network"
28		case "resolve":
29			return "SSH hostname could not be resolved; inspect the saved SSH alias and DNS"
30		case "closed":
31			return "SSH connection closed before the helper completed; inspect transport and SSH service logs"
32		default:
33			return "SSH transport did not complete; inspect the selected host's SSH route and firewall"
34		}
35	}
36	func classifySSHTransport(err error, diagnostic string) *SSHTransportError {
37		var exit *exec.ExitError
38		if !errors.As(err, &exit) || exit.ExitCode() != 255 {
39			return nil
40		}
41		message := strings.ToLower(diagnostic)
42		switch {
43		case strings.Contains(message, "could not resolve hostname"):
44			return &SSHTransportError{Kind: "resolve"}
45		case strings.Contains(message, "connection timed out during banner exchange"):
46			return &SSHTransportError{Kind: "timeout"}
47		case strings.Contains(message, "connect to host") && (strings.Contains(message, "connection timed out") || strings.Contains(message, "operation timed out")):
48			return &SSHTransportError{Kind: "timeout"}
49		case strings.Contains(message, "connect to host") && strings.Contains(message, "connection refused"):
50			return &SSHTransportError{Kind: "refused"}
51		case strings.Contains(message, "connect to host") && (strings.Contains(message, "no route to host") || strings.Contains(message, "network is unreachable")):
52			return &SSHTransportError{Kind: "unreachable"}
53		case strings.Contains(message, "connection closed by") || strings.Contains(message, "connection reset by") || strings.Contains(message, "kex_exchange_identification:"):
54			return &SSHTransportError{Kind: "closed"}
55		}
56		return nil
57	}
58	
59	// ExecutePython runs caller-owned fixed helper code, with all request data on
60	// stdin. An empty host means local execution. It never installs a helper or
61	// exposes stderr, which may contain source/configuration data.
62	func ExecutePython(ctx context.Context, host, script string, input []byte, limit int) ([]byte, error) {
63		if len(input) > 32<<20 || limit <= 0 || limit > 32<<20 {
64			return nil, errors.New("helper request or output limit is invalid")
65		}
66		var cmd *exec.Cmd
67		if host == "" {
68			path, err := exec.LookPath("python3")
69			if err != nil {
70				return nil, ErrPythonUnavailable
71			}
72			cmd = commandContext(ctx, path, "-c", script)
73		} else {
74			if err := validateHost(host); err != nil {
75				return nil, err
76			}
77			args, err := sshArgsContext(ctx, host)
78			if err != nil {
79				return nil, err
80			}
81			cmd = commandContext(ctx, "ssh", append(args, "-T", "--", host, "python3 -c "+shellQuote(script))...)
82		}
83		var output, diagnostic limitedBuffer
84		output.limit, diagnostic.limit = limit, 8192
85		cmd.Stdin, cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = bytes.NewReader(input), &output, &diagnostic
86		configureHelperProcess(cmd)
87		cmd.WaitDelay = 2 * time.Second
88		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
89			if ctx.Err() != nil {
90				return nil, ctx.Err()
91			}
92			if output.Exceeded() || diagnostic.Exceeded() {
93				return nil, ErrHelperOutputLimit
94			}
95			if host != "" && needsAuthentication(diagnostic.String()) {
96				return nil, &AuthRequiredError{Host: host}
97			}
98			if host != "" {
99				if transport := classifySSHTransport(err, diagnostic.String()); transport != nil {
100					return nil, transport
101				}
102			}
103			message := strings.ToLower(diagnostic.String())
104			if strings.Contains(message, "python3") && (strings.Contains(message, "not found") || strings.Contains(message, "no such file")) {
105				return nil, ErrPythonUnavailable
106			}
107			return nil, ErrHelperFailed
108		}
109		return output.Bytes(), nil
110	}

100	func validateHost(host string) error {
101		if host == "" {
102			return errors.New("SSH host is required")
103		}
104		return config.ValidateTarget(config.Target{Controller: "http://127.0.0.1:9090", SSHHost: host})
105	}
106	
107	func batchSSHArgs(controlPath string) []string {
108		args := []string{"-o", "BatchMode=yes", "-o", "ConnectTimeout=8", "-o", "StrictHostKeyChecking=yes", "-o", "ServerAliveInterval=15", "-o", "ServerAliveCountMax=2", "-o", "ControlMaster=no"}
109		if controlPath == "" {
110			controlPath = "none"
111		}
112		return append(args, "-o", "ControlPath="+controlSocketArgument(controlPath))
113	}
114	
115	func sshArgs(host string) []string {
116		var policy multiplexPolicy
117		multiplexPolicies.Lock()
118		if entry := multiplexPolicies.entries[host]; entry != nil && entry.ready == nil {
119			policy = entry.policy
120		}
121		multiplexPolicies.Unlock()
122		authentications.Lock()
123		a, ok := authentications.hosts[host]
124		authentications.Unlock()
125		if ok {
126			return append(batchSSHArgs(a.path), "-o", "ClearAllForwardings=yes")
127		}
128		return append(batchSSHArgs(policy.path), "-o", "ClearAllForwardings=yes")
129	}
130	
131	func sshArgsContext(ctx context.Context, host string) ([]string, error) {
132		if _, err := resolveMultiplexPolicy(ctx, host); err != nil {
133			return nil, err
134		}
135		return sshArgs(host), nil
136	}
137	
138	// Remote command strings contain only fixed script text or single-quoted paths.
139	func shellQuote(s string) string { return "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(s, "'", "'\"'\"'") + "'" }
140	
141	func remoteCommand(ctx context.Context, host, script string, limit int) ([]byte, error) {
142		if err := validateHost(host); err != nil {
143			return nil, err
144		}
145		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 15*time.Second)
146		defer cancel()
147		base, err := sshArgsContext(ctx, host)
148		if err != nil {
149			return nil, err
150		}

14	## Operating workflow
15	
16	1. Identify the intended core with `lazyclash targets list --json`; use
17	   `lazyclash targets discover --json` when a controller needs to be found.
18	   Select a registered target or an explicit controller, then keep that same
19	   selection on every command in the operation. Never silently switch targets
20	   after a failure.
21	2. Test reachability with `targets test ID --json` when needed. Inspect current state before choosing an action. Use JSON to obtain actual
22	   group and member names, including Unicode and spaces; do not invent them.
23	3. Perform the change within the user's authorized scope, then read back the
24	   relevant state. An uncertain write can have succeeded: refresh first and
25	   do not blindly retry or claim rollback.
26	
27	For a registered target, set `TARGET` to its actual ID. Set `GROUP` and `MEMBER`
28	from the returned proxy data and the user's requested selection:

30	```sh
31	lazyclash --target "$TARGET" status --json
32	lazyclash --target "$TARGET" proxies list --json
33	lazyclash --target "$TARGET" proxies select "$GROUP" "$MEMBER" --json
34	lazyclash --target "$TARGET" proxies list --json
35	```

37	`--read-only` blocks core control actions, active egress/latency tests and proxy

105	func Discover(ctx context.Context, sshHost string) ([]config.Target, error) {
106		if sshHost != "" {
107			return discoverRemote(ctx, sshHost)
108		}
109		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
110		if err != nil {
111			return nil, errors.New("cannot locate home directory for local discovery")
112		}
113		paths := knownPaths(home, os.Getenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME"), os.Getenv("XDG_DATA_HOME"))
114		psCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 2*time.Second)
115		ps, _ := commandContext(psCtx, "ps", "-axo", "pid=,command=").Output()
116		cancel()
117		paths = uniquePaths(append(processConfigPaths(string(ps)), paths...))
118		var candidates []config.Target
119		for _, path := range paths {
120			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
121				return nil, err
122			}
123			data, err := readLimitedFile(path, maxConfigBytes)
124			if err != nil {
125				continue
126			}
127			runtime, err := parseRuntime(data)
128			if err != nil {
129				continue
130			}
131			for _, endpoint := range runtime.controllers() {
132				t := candidate(endpoint, path, "", runtime)
133				if runtime.complete() {
134					t.Configs = append(t.Configs, config.CoreConfig{ID: "runtime", Name: "Runtime YAML", Path: path})
135				}
136				t.Configs = append(t.Configs, localProfiles(filepath.Dir(path))...)
137				candidates = append(candidates, t)
138			}
139		}
140		for _, endpoint := range processListeners(ctx, "", string(ps)) {
141			candidates = append(candidates, candidate(endpoint, "", "", runtimeConfig{}))
142		}
143		return probeCandidates(ctx, candidates, ""), ctx.Err()
144	}
145	
146	func candidate(endpoint, path, sshHost string, runtime runtimeConfig) config.Target {
147		hash := sha256.Sum256([]byte(sshHost + "\x00" + endpoint))
148		name := endpoint
149		if path != "" {
150			name = filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(path)) + " · " + endpoint
151		}
152		if sshHost != "" {
153			name = sshHost + " · " + name
154		}
155		return config.Target{ID: "core-" + hex.EncodeToString(hash[:4]), Name: name, Controller: endpoint, SSHHost: sshHost, SourceConfig: path, Secret: runtime.Secret}
156	}
157	
158	func probeCandidates(ctx context.Context, candidates []config.Target, sshHost string) []config.Target {
159		// Source-backed and process-owned endpoints retain priority. The two known
160		// defaults get independent empty credentials and never borrow another core's.
161		seen := map[string]bool{}
162		for _, t := range candidates {
163			seen[t.Controller] = true
164		}
165		for _, port := range []string{"9090", "9097"} {
166			endpoint := "http://127.0.0.1:" + port
167			if !seen[endpoint] {
168				candidates = append(candidates, candidate(endpoint, "", sshHost, runtimeConfig{}))
169			}
170		}
171		return probeBatch(ctx, candidates)
172	}
173	
174	func probeBatch(ctx context.Context, candidates []config.Target) []config.Target {
175		// Keep deterministic configuration order even when probes finish out of order.
176		results := make([]*config.Target, len(candidates))
177		limit := make(chan struct{}, 4)
178		var wg sync.WaitGroup
179		for i, t := range candidates {
180			if ctx.Err() != nil {
181				break
182			}
183			wg.Add(1)
184			go func(i int, t config.Target) {
185				defer wg.Done()
186				select {
187				case limit <- struct{}{}:
188				case <-ctx.Done():
189					return
190				}
191				defer func() { <-limit }()
192				probeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 3*time.Second)
193				defer cancel()
194				// Discovery already read the candidate's source. Open's ordinary path
195				// re-reads it later so saved targets never retain stale credentials.
196				probeTarget := t
197				probeTarget.SourceConfig = ""
198				_, closer, err := Open(probeCtx, probeTarget, true)
199				if err != nil {
200					var coreErr *core.Error
201					if errors.As(err, &coreErr) && coreErr.Kind == core.KindAuth {
202						t.AuthRequired = true
203						results[i] = &t
204					}
205					return
206				}
207				defer closer.Close()
208				results[i] = &t
209			}(i, t)
210		}
211		wg.Wait()
212		byEndpoint := map[string]int{}
213		var found []config.Target
214		for _, result := range results {
215			if result == nil {
216				continue
217			}
218			t := *result
219			key := t.SSHHost + "\x00" + t.Controller
220			if prior, ok := byEndpoint[key]; ok {
221				if found[prior].AuthRequired && !t.AuthRequired {
222					found[prior] = t
223				}
224				continue
225			}
226			byEndpoint[key] = len(found)
227			found = append(found, t)
228		}
229		return found
230	}
231	
232	func knownPaths(home, xdgConfig, xdgData string) []string {
233		if !filepath.IsAbs(xdgConfig) {
234			xdgConfig = filepath.Join(home, ".config")
235		}
236		if !filepath.IsAbs(xdgData) {
237			xdgData = filepath.Join(home, ".local", "share")
238		}
239		var dirs []string
240		for _, name := range []string{"mihomo", "clash", "clash-verge", "clash-verge-rev"} {
241			dirs = append(dirs, filepath.Join(xdgConfig, name))
242		}
243		for _, name := range []string{"io.github.clash-verge-rev.clash-verge-rev", "io.github.clash-verge-rev.clash-verge", "com.github.zzzgydi.clashverge", "io.github.zzzgydi.clash-verge"} {
244			dirs = append(dirs, filepath.Join(home, "Library", "Application Support", name), filepath.Join(xdgData, name))
245		}
246		for _, name := range []string{"mihomo", "clash", "ClashX", "ClashMetaX"} {
247			dirs = append(dirs, filepath.Join(home, "Library", "Application Support", name))
248		}
249		dirs = append(dirs, "/etc/mihomo", "/etc/clash")
250		var paths []string
251		for _, dir := range dirs {
252			for _, name := range []string{"clash-verge.yaml", "config.yaml", "config.yml"} {
253				paths = append(paths, filepath.Join(dir, name))
254			}
255		}
256		return paths
257	}

122		if opts.ReadOnly {
123			return Receipt{}, errors.New("source edits are disabled in read-only mode")
124		}
125		if len(expected) != 64 {
126			return Receipt{}, errors.New("apply needs the digest from a fresh preview")

130			return Receipt{}, e
131		}

158			return Receipt{}, e
159		}

163			}

165				return Receipt{}, e
166			}

175			if err != nil {

177				r.Status = "write_result_unknown"
178				r.Message = "A source write was not confirmed; verify or restore this receipt before retrying."
179				r.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
180				_ = saveReceipt(opts, r)
181				return r, fmt.Errorf("%w: %w", &core.Error{Kind: core.KindUnknownWrite, Operation: "write configuration source"}, err)

243	func Verify(ctx context.Context, t config.Target, id string, opts Options) (Receipt, error) {
244		r, e := loadReceipt(opts, id)
245		if e != nil {
246			return r, e
247		}
248		if r.Composite != nil {
249			return verifyChangeSetReceipt(ctx, t, r, opts)
250		}
251		if r.Binding != Binding(t) {
252			return r, errors.New("receipt belongs to a different source binding")
253		}
254		s, e := inspectWithOptions(ctx, t, opts)
255		if e != nil {
256			return r, e
257		}
258		if r.OwnerIdentity != "" && r.OwnerIdentity != s.dockerID+":"+s.dockerImage {
259			return r, errors.New("Docker owner identity changed; receipt is not applicable")
260		}
261		r.SourceVerified = true
262		for i, ch := range r.Changes {
263			f, ok := s.files[ch.Path]
264			if !ok {
265				return r, errors.New("receipt file no longer belongs to source")
266			}
267			want := ch.AfterSHA256
268			if r.Restored {
269				want = ch.BeforeSHA256
270			}
271			if f.SHA256 != want {
272				r.SourceVerified = false
273			}
274			if f.SHA256 == ch.AfterSHA256 {
275				r.Changes[i].Status = "written"
276			} else if f.SHA256 == ch.BeforeSHA256 {
277				r.Changes[i].Status = "original"
278			} else {
279				r.Changes[i].Status = "changed"
280			}
281		}
282		r.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC()
283		r.GeneratedVerified = false
284		r.RuntimeObserved = false
285		if !r.SourceVerified {
286			r.Status = "source_changed"
287			r.Message = "Not all current source bytes match this receipt; inspect before applying or restoring."
288			_ = saveReceipt(opts, r)
289			return r, nil
290		}
291		if r.Owner == "docker" && s.dockerSourceSHA != s.files[s.base].SHA256 {
292			r.GeneratedVerified = false
293			r.RuntimeObserved = false
294			r.Status = "persisted_pending_owner_reload"
295			r.Message = "Container-visible source differs from the saved host source; reactivate its owner before verification."

16		}

18			gb   int
19			name string
20		}{{32, "E4"}, {64, "E6"}, {128, "E10"}, {256, "E15"}, {512, "E20"}, {1024, "E30"}} {
21			if gb > 0 && gb <= tier.gb {
22				return tier.name, nil
23			}
24		}
25		return "", fmt.Errorf("Azure Standard SSD boot disk must be 32–1024 GiB")
26	}
