```text
105	func Discover(ctx context.Context, sshHost string) ([]config.Target, error) {
106		if sshHost != "" {
107			return discoverRemote(ctx, sshHost)
108		}
109		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
110		if err != nil {
111			return nil, errors.New("cannot locate home directory for local discovery")
112		}
113		paths := knownPaths(home, os.Getenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME"), os.Getenv("XDG_DATA_HOME"))
114		psCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 2*time.Second)
115		ps, _ := commandContext(psCtx, "ps", "-axo", "pid=,command=").Output()
116		cancel()
117		paths = uniquePaths(append(processConfigPaths(string(ps)), paths...))
118		var candidates []config.Target
119		for _, path := range paths {
120			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
121				return nil, err
122			}
123			data, err := readLimitedFile(path, maxConfigBytes)
124			if err != nil {
125				continue
126			}
127			runtime, err := parseRuntime(data)
128			if err != nil {
129				continue
130			}
131			for _, endpoint := range runtime.controllers() {
132				t := candidate(endpoint, path, "", runtime)
133				if runtime.complete() {
134					t.Configs = append(t.Configs, config.CoreConfig{ID: "runtime", Name: "Runtime YAML", Path: path})
135				}
136				t.Configs = append(t.Configs, localProfiles(filepath.Dir(path))...)
137				candidates = append(candidates, t)
138			}
139		}
140		for _, endpoint := range processListeners(ctx, "", string(ps)) {
141			candidates = append(candidates, candidate(endpoint, "", "", runtimeConfig{}))
142		}
143		return probeCandidates(ctx, candidates, ""), ctx.Err()
144	}
145	
146	func candidate(endpoint, path, sshHost string, runtime runtimeConfig) config.Target {
147		hash := sha256.Sum256([]byte(sshHost + "\x00" + endpoint))
148		name := endpoint
149		if path != "" {
150			name = filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(path)) + " · " + endpoint
151		}
152		if sshHost != "" {
153			name = sshHost + " · " + name
154		}
155		return config.Target{ID: "core-" + hex.EncodeToString(hash[:4]), Name: name, Controller: endpoint, SSHHost: sshHost, SourceConfig: path, Secret: runtime.Secret}
156	}
157	
158	func probeCandidates(ctx context.Context, candidates []config.Target, sshHost string) []config.Target {
159		// Source-backed and process-owned endpoints retain priority. The two known
160		// defaults get independent empty credentials and never borrow another core's.
161		seen := map[string]bool{}
162		for _, t := range candidates {
163			seen[t.Controller] = true
164		}
165		for _, port := range []string{"9090", "9097"} {
166			endpoint := "http://127.0.0.1:" + port
167			if !seen[endpoint] {
168				candidates = append(candidates, candidate(endpoint, "", sshHost, runtimeConfig{}))
169			}
170		}
171		return probeBatch(ctx, candidates)
172	}
173	
174	func probeBatch(ctx context.Context, candidates []config.Target) []config.Target {
175		// Keep deterministic configuration order even when probes finish out of order.
176		results := make([]*config.Target, len(candidates))
177		limit := make(chan struct{}, 4)
178		var wg sync.WaitGroup
179		for i, t := range candidates {
180			if ctx.Err() != nil {
181				break
182			}
183			wg.Add(1)
184			go func(i int, t config.Target) {
185				defer wg.Done()
186				select {
187				case limit <- struct{}{}:
188				case <-ctx.Done():
189					return
190				}
191				defer func() { <-limit }()
192				probeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 3*time.Second)
193				defer cancel()
194				// Discovery already read the candidate's source. Open's ordinary path
195				// re-reads it later so saved targets never retain stale credentials.
196				probeTarget := t
197				probeTarget.SourceConfig = ""
198				_, closer, err := Open(probeCtx, probeTarget, true)
199				if err != nil {
200					var coreErr *core.Error
201					if errors.As(err, &coreErr) && coreErr.Kind == core.KindAuth {
202						t.AuthRequired = true
203						results[i] = &t
204					}
205					return
206				}
207				defer closer.Close()
208				results[i] = &t
209			}(i, t)
210		}
211		wg.Wait()
212		byEndpoint := map[string]int{}
213		var found []config.Target
214		for _, result := range results {
215			if result == nil {
216				continue
217			}
218			t := *result
219			key := t.SSHHost + "\x00" + t.Controller
220			if prior, ok := byEndpoint[key]; ok {
221				if found[prior].AuthRequired && !t.AuthRequired {
222					found[prior] = t
223				}
224				continue
225			}
226			byEndpoint[key] = len(found)
227			found = append(found, t)
228		}
229		return found
230	}
```

```text
1	package core

3	import (
4		"strings"
5		"unicode"
6	)
7	
8	// Sanitize removes terminal escape sequences and control characters from remote
9	// text. Apply it only at display boundaries: original names must reach the API.
10	// Newlines and tabs are retained so multi-line log records remain readable.
11	func Sanitize(text string) string {
12		const (
13			plain = iota
14			escaped
15			csi
16			stringEscape
17			stringEnd
18		)
19		state := plain
20		var out strings.Builder
21		out.Grow(len(text))
22		for _, r := range text {
23			switch state {
24			case plain:
25				switch r {
26				case '\x1b':
27					state = escaped
28				case '\u009b':
29					state = csi
30				case '\u009d', '\u0090', '\u009e', '\u009f':
31					state = stringEscape
32				default:
33					if r == '\n' || r == '\t' || (!unicode.IsControl(r) && !isBidiControl(r)) {
34						out.WriteRune(r)
35					}
36				}
37			case escaped:
38				switch r {
39				case '[':
40					state = csi
41				case ']', 'P', '^', '_':
42					state = stringEscape
43				default:
44					if r >= 0x30 && r <= 0x7e {
45						state = plain
46					}
47				}
48			case csi:
49				if r >= 0x40 && r <= 0x7e {
50					state = plain
51				}
52			case stringEscape:
53				if r == '\a' || r == '\u009c' {
54					state = plain
55				} else if r == '\x1b' {
56					state = stringEnd
57				}
58			case stringEnd:
59				if r == '\\' || r == '\a' || r == '\u009c' {
60					state = plain
61				} else {
62					state = stringEscape
63				}
64			}
65		}
66		return out.String()
67	}
68	
69	func isBidiControl(r rune) bool {
70		return r == '\u061c' || r == '\u200e' || r == '\u200f' || r >= '\u202a' && r <= '\u202e' || r >= '\u2066' && r <= '\u2069'
71	}
```

```text
62	func ExecutePython(ctx context.Context, host, script string, input []byte, limit int) ([]byte, error) {
63		if len(input) > 32<<20 || limit <= 0 || limit > 32<<20 {
64			return nil, errors.New("helper request or output limit is invalid")
65		}
66		var cmd *exec.Cmd
67		if host == "" {
68			path, err := exec.LookPath("python3")
69			if err != nil {
70				return nil, ErrPythonUnavailable
71			}
72			cmd = commandContext(ctx, path, "-c", script)

74			if err := validateHost(host); err != nil {
75				return nil, err
76			}
77			args, err := sshArgsContext(ctx, host)
78			if err != nil {
79				return nil, err
80			}
81			cmd = commandContext(ctx, "ssh", append(args, "-T", "--", host, "python3 -c "+shellQuote(script))...)
82		}
83		var output, diagnostic limitedBuffer
84		output.limit, diagnostic.limit = limit, 8192
85		cmd.Stdin, cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = bytes.NewReader(input), &output, &diagnostic
86		configureHelperProcess(cmd)
87		cmd.WaitDelay = 2 * time.Second
88		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
89			if ctx.Err() != nil {
90				return nil, ctx.Err()
91			}
92			if output.Exceeded() || diagnostic.Exceeded() {
93				return nil, ErrHelperOutputLimit
94			}
95			if host != "" && needsAuthentication(diagnostic.String()) {

97			}
98			if host != "" {
99				if transport := classifySSHTransport(err, diagnostic.String()); transport != nil {
100					return nil, transport
101				}
102			}
103			message := strings.ToLower(diagnostic.String())
104			if strings.Contains(message, "python3") && (strings.Contains(message, "not found") || strings.Contains(message, "no such file")) {
105				return nil, ErrPythonUnavailable
106			}
107			return nil, ErrHelperFailed
108		}
109		return output.Bytes(), nil
```

```text
55	func (r runtimeConfig) controllers() []string {
56		var endpoints []string
57		for _, entry := range []struct{ value, scheme string }{{r.Controller, "http"}, {r.TLSController, "https"}, {r.UnixController, "unix"}} {
58			if entry.value == "" {
59				continue
60			}
61			e, err := normalizeController(entry.value, entry.scheme)
62			if err == nil {
63				endpoints = append(endpoints, e)
64			}
65		}
66		return endpoints
67	}
68	func (r runtimeConfig) matches(controller string) bool {
69		for _, endpoint := range r.controllers() {
70			if endpoint == strings.TrimSuffix(controller, "/") {
71				return true
72			}
73		}
74		return false
75	}
76	
77	func normalizeController(value, scheme string) (string, error) {
78		value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
79		if scheme == "unix" {
80			if !strings.HasPrefix(value, "unix://") {
81				value = "unix://" + value
82			}
83		} else if !strings.Contains(value, "://") {
84			host, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(value)
85			if err != nil {
86				return "", err
87			}
88			if host == "" || host == "0.0.0.0" || host == "*" {
89				host = "127.0.0.1"
90			}
91			if host == "::" {
92				host = "::1"
93			}
94			value = scheme + "://" + net.JoinHostPort(host, port)
95		}
96		if err := config.ValidateController(value); err != nil {
97			return "", err
98		}
99		return strings.TrimSuffix(value, "/"), nil
100	}
101	
102	// Discover only reads runtime configuration and probes GET /version. It never
103	// falls back during Open of an explicitly chosen target. A 401 is exposed as an
104	// authentication-needed candidate, not mistaken for a usable controller.
```

```text
203	func (a azureAdapter) images(ctx context.Context, r CreateRequest) ([]Choice, error) {

208			}
209			ss, e := a.sizes(ctx, r)
210			if e != nil {
211				return nil, e
212			}
213			for _, s := range ss {
214				if s.name == r.Plan {
215					arch = s.arch
216				}
217			}
218		}
219		sku := "server"
220		if arch == "arm64" {
221			sku = "server-arm64"
222		} else if arch != "amd64" {
223			return nil, fmt.Errorf("Azure image architecture is not resolved")
224		}
225		v, e := a.call(ctx, r, "vm", "image", "list", "--location", r.Region, "--publisher", "Canonical", "--offer", "ubuntu-24_04-lts", "--sku", sku, "--all")
226		if e != nil {
227			return nil, e
228		}
229		rows, e := strictItems(v)
230		if e != nil {
231			return nil, e
232		}
233		var out []Choice
234		for _, m := range rows {
235			if !strings.EqualFold(str(m["publisher"]), "Canonical") || str(m["offer"]) != "ubuntu-24_04-lts" || str(m["sku"]) != sku {
236				continue
237			}
238			ver := str(m["version"])
239			if ver == "" || ver == "latest" {
240				continue
241			}
242			out = append(out, Choice{ID: "Canonical:ubuntu-24_04-lts:" + sku + ":" + ver, Label: "Ubuntu 24.04 " + arch + " · " + ver})
243		}
244		sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return azureVersionLess(out[i].ID, out[j].ID) })
245		if len(out) == 0 {
246			return nil, fmt.Errorf("no pinned Canonical Ubuntu 24.04 image available")
247		}
248		return out, nil
249	}
250	func azureVersionLess(a, b string) bool {
251		aa := strings.Split(a[strings.LastIndex(a, ":")+1:], ".")
252		bb := strings.Split(b[strings.LastIndex(b, ":")+1:], ".")
253		for i := 0; i < len(aa) && i < len(bb); i++ {
254			x, _ := strconv.Atoi(aa[i])
255			y, _ := strconv.Atoi(bb[i])
256			if x != y {
257				return x < y
258			}
259		}
260		return a < b
```

```text
13	func azureDiskTier(gb int) (string, error) {
14		if gb < 32 {
15			return "", fmt.Errorf("Azure Ubuntu boot disk requires at least 32 GiB")
16		}
17		for _, tier := range []struct {
18			gb   int
19			name string
20		}{{32, "E4"}, {64, "E6"}, {128, "E10"}, {256, "E15"}, {512, "E20"}, {1024, "E30"}} {
21			if gb > 0 && gb <= tier.gb {
22				return tier.name, nil
23			}
24		}
25		return "", fmt.Errorf("Azure Standard SSD boot disk must be 32–1024 GiB")
26	}
27	func (a azureAdapter) prices(ctx context.Context, r CreateRequest, filter string) ([]map[string]any, error) {
28		u := azurePriceSource + "?" + url.Values{"api-version": {"2023-01-01-preview"}, "currencyCode": {"'USD'"}, "$filter": {"armRegionName eq '" + strings.ReplaceAll(r.Region, "'", "''") + "' and priceType eq 'Consumption' and " + filter}}.Encode()
29		seen := map[string]bool{}
30		var out []map[string]any
31		for page := 0; u != ""; page++ {
32			if page >= 100 || seen[u] {
33				return nil, fmt.Errorf("Azure Retail price pagination is incomplete or cyclic")
34			}
35			seen[u] = true
36			p, err := url.Parse(u)
37			if err != nil || p.Scheme != "https" || p.Host != "prices.azure.com" || p.User != nil || p.Path != "/api/retail/prices" {
38				return nil, fmt.Errorf("untrusted Azure Retail price page URL")
39			}
40			v, err := a.s.cloudHTTPJSON(ctx, u)
41			if err != nil {
42				return nil, err
43			}
44			m := obj(v)
45			if str(m["BillingCurrency"]) != "USD" {
46				return nil, fmt.Errorf("Azure Retail response is not USD")
47			}
48			rows, err := strictItems(v, "Items")
49			if err != nil {
50				return nil, err
51			}
52			for _, row := range rows {
53				if str(row["currencyCode"]) != "USD" || str(row["type"]) != "Consumption" || str(row["armRegionName"]) != r.Region {
54					continue
55				}
56				if date := str(row["effectiveStartDate"]); date != "" {
57					t, e := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, date)
58					if e != nil || t.After(a.s.options.Now()) {
59						continue
60					}
61				}
62				if f, ok := row["retailPrice"].(float64); !ok || f < 0 || math.IsNaN(f) || math.IsInf(f, 0) {
63					continue
64				}
65				out = append(out, row)
66			}
67			if next, ok := m["NextPageLink"]; ok && next != nil {
68				var valid bool
69				u, valid = next.(string)
70				if !valid {
71					return nil, fmt.Errorf("malformed Azure Retail NextPageLink")
72				}
73			} else {
74				u = ""
75			}
76		}
77		return out, nil
78	}
79	func azureSinglePrice(rows []map[string]any, accept func(map[string]any) bool) (float64, error) {
80		latest := map[string]map[string]any{}
81		for _, r := range rows {
82			if !accept(r) || num(r["tierMinimumUnits"]) != 0 {
83				continue
84			}
85			id := str(r["meterId"])
86			if id == "" {
87				return 0, fmt.Errorf("Azure Retail price lacks meter identity")
88			}
89			if prior := latest[id]; prior == nil || str(prior["effectiveStartDate"]) < str(r["effectiveStartDate"]) {
90				latest[id] = r
91			}
92		}
93		var price float64
94		found := false
95		for _, r := range latest {
96			p := num(r["retailPrice"])
97			if p <= 0 {
98				return 0, fmt.Errorf("Azure price is missing or nonpositive")
99			}
100			if found && p != price {
101				return 0, fmt.Errorf("Azure Retail price is ambiguous")
102			}
103			found = true
104			price = p
105		}
106		if !found {
107			return 0, fmt.Errorf("Azure Retail has no exact on-demand price for the selected component")
108		}
109		return price, nil
110	}
111	func (a azureAdapter) quoteSize(ctx context.Context, r CreateRequest, size azureSize) (Quote, error) {

Standard SSD disk and static IPv4 continue billing; disk I/O transactions, outbound traffic and tax are additional."}}

127			return str(m["serviceName"]) == "Virtual Machines" && str(m["armSkuName"]) == size.name && strings.HasPrefix(p, "Virtual Machines ") && !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(p), "windows") && !strings.Contains(n, "spot") && !strings.Contains(n, "low priority") && str(m["unitOfMeasure"]) == "1 Hour"
128		})
129		if err != nil {

138		})
139		if err != nil {
140			return q, fmt.Errorf("Azure disk: %w", err)
141		}
142		ipRows, err := a.prices(ctx, r, "serviceName eq 'Virtual Network' and meterName eq 'Standard IPv4 Static Public IP'")
143		if err != nil {

148		})
149		if err != nil {
150			return q, fmt.Errorf("Azure IPv4: %w", err)
151		}
152		q.Components = []CostComponent{{Name: "compute", MonthlyUSD: compute * 730, Unit: "hour", UnitUSD: compute, Quantity: 730, Source: azurePriceSource}, {Name: "disk", MonthlyUSD: disk, Unit: tier + " LRS Disk/month", UnitUSD: disk, Quantity: 1, Source: azurePriceSource}, {Name: "ipv4", MonthlyUSD: ip * 730, Unit: "hour", UnitUSD: ip, Quantity: 730, Source: azurePriceSource}}
153		q.MonthlyUSD = math.Round((compute*730+disk+ip*730)*10000) / 10000
154		stopped := disk + ip*730

156		traffic, err := a.prices(ctx, r, "serviceName eq 'Bandwidth' and productName eq 'Rtn Preference: MGN' and meterName eq 'Standard Data Transfer Out'")
157		if err != nil {

166	func azureTransferPricing(rows []map[string]any, now time.Time) (*TransferPricing, error) {
167		latest := map[float64]map[string]any{}
168		meter := ""
169		for _, m := range rows {
170			if str(m["serviceName"]) != "Bandwidth" || str(m["productName"]) != "Rtn Preference: MGN" || str(m["meterName"]) != "Standard Data Transfer Out" || str(m["unitOfMeasure"]) != "1 GB" {
171				continue
172			}
173			id := str(m["meterId"])
174			if id == "" || (meter != "" && id != meter) {
175				return nil, fmt.Errorf("Azure outbound meter is missing or ambiguous")
176			}
177			meter = id
178			from := num(m["tierMinimumUnits"])
179			if from < 0 {
180				return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid Azure transfer tier")
181			}
182			if old := latest[from]; old == nil || str(old["effectiveStartDate"]) < str(m["effectiveStartDate"]) {
183				latest[from] = m
184			}
185		}
186		var paid []PriceTier
187		for from, m := range latest {
188			if num(m["retailPrice"]) > 0 {
189				paid = append(paid, PriceTier{From: from, USD: num(m["retailPrice"])})
190			}
191		}
192		sort.Slice(paid, func(i, j int) bool { return paid[i].From < paid[j].From })
193		if len(paid) == 0 {
194			return nil, fmt.Errorf("Azure Retail did not return a paid internet outbound tier")
195		}
196		shared := paid[0].From
197		for i := range paid {
198			paid[i].From -= shared
199			if i+1 < len(paid) {
200				paid[i].To = paid[i+1].From - shared
201			}
202		}
203		return &TransferPricing{Basis: "outbound", Tiers: paid, Source: azurePriceSource, Checked: now.UTC().Format("2006-01-02"), SharedAllowanceGB: shared}, nil
204	}
205
```

 `./internal/cli/server_connect.go`

```text
1	package cli
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"crypto/sha256"
6		"encoding/hex"
7		"encoding/json"
8		"errors"
9		"fmt"
10		"github.com/daviddwlee84/lazyclash/internal/privatefs"
11		"os"
12		"path/filepath"
13		"time"
14	
15		"github.com/daviddwlee84/lazyclash/internal/config"
16		"github.com/daviddwlee84/lazyclash/internal/configwork"
17		"github.com/daviddwlee84/lazyclash/internal/serverstate"
18		"github.com/spf13/cobra"
19	)
20	
21	// The connection record is saved before a client write. A scoped configwork
22	// receipt directory lets an interrupted process recover its receipt without
23	// guessing whether it should perform the import again.
24	type serverConnection struct {
25		ServerID  string    `json:"server_id"`
26		TargetID  string    `json:"target_id"`
27		Binding   string    `json:"binding"`
28		Digest    string    `json:"digest"`
29		Status    string    `json:"status"`
30		ReceiptID string    `json:"receipt_id,omitempty"`
31		StartedAt time.Time `json:"started_at"`
32	}
33	
34	func serverConnectionPath(store serverstate.Store, id string, target config.Target) (string, error) {
35		return clientConnectionPath(store, "server", id, target)
36	}
37	
38	func clientConnectionPath(store serverstate.Store, kind, id string, target config.Target) (string, error) {
39		if err := serverstate.ValidateID(id); err != nil {
40			return "", err
41		}
42		root, err := store.StateRoot()
43		if err != nil {
44			return "", err
45		}
46		identity := id // Preserve receipts written before Tailnet support.
47		if kind != "server" {
48			identity = kind + "\x00" + id
49		}
50		sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(identity + "\x00" + target.ID + "\x00" + configwork.Binding(target)))
51		return filepath.Join(root, "connections", hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]), "connection.json"), nil
52	}
53	
54	func readServerConnection(path string) (serverConnection, bool, error) {
55		var record serverConnection
56		info, err := os.Lstat(path)
57		if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
58			return record, false, nil
59		}
60		if err != nil {
61			return record, false, err
62		}
63		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || !privatefs.Private(path) || info.Size() > 1<<20 {
64			return record, false, errors.New("saved server-client import record is not a private regular file")
65		}
66		data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
67		if err != nil {
68			return record, false, err
69		}
70		if err = json.Unmarshal(data, &record); err != nil {
71			return record, false, errors.New("invalid saved server-client import record")
72		}
73		if record.ServerID == "" || record.TargetID == "" || record.Binding == "" || record.StartedAt.IsZero() {
74			return record, false, errors.New("incomplete saved server-client import record")
75		}
76		return record, true, nil
77	}
78	
79	func saveServerConnection(path string, record serverConnection) error {
80		data, err := json.MarshalIndent(record, "", "  ")
81		if err != nil {
82			return err
83		}
84		return serverstate.WritePrivate(path, data)
85	}
86	
87	func applyServerConnection(ctx context.Context, store serverstate.Store, id string, target config.Target, req configwork.Request, expected, path string, opts configwork.Options) (configwork.Receipt, error) {
88		return applyClientConnection(ctx, store, "server", id, target, req, expected, path, opts)
89	}
90	
91	func applyClientConnection(ctx context.Context, store serverstate.Store, kind, id string, target config.Target, req configwork.Request, expected, path string, opts configwork.Options) (configwork.Receipt, error) {
92		command := "servers connect"
93		if kind == "tailnet-proxy" {
94			command = "tailnet proxy connect"
95		}
96	
97		if opts.ReadOnly {
98			return configwork.Receipt{}, errors.New("client import is disabled in read-only mode")
99		}
100		unlock, err := serverstate.Lock(path + ".lock")
101		if err != nil {
102			return configwork.Receipt{}, err
103		}
104		defer unlock()
105		previous, found, err := readServerConnection(path)
106		if err != nil {
107			return configwork.Receipt{}, err
108		}
109		if found && previous.Status != "failed-before-write" {
110			return configwork.Receipt{}, usage("an import is already recorded; run %s %s --verify --target %s", command, id, target.ID)
111		}
112		record := serverConnection{ServerID: id, TargetID: target.ID, Binding: configwork.Binding(target), Digest: expected, Status: "applying", StartedAt: time.Now().UTC()}
113		if err = saveServerConnection(path, record); err != nil {
114			return configwork.Receipt{}, err
115		}
116		result, applyErr := configwork.Apply(ctx, target, req, expected, opts)
117		if result.ID == "" {
118			record.Status = "failed-before-write"
119		} else {
120			record.ReceiptID = result.ID
121			record.Status = result.Status
122		}
123		if err = saveServerConnection(path, record); err != nil {
124			return result, errors.Join(applyErr, fmt.Errorf("save client import result: %w; use %s --verify before retrying", err, command))
125		}
126		return result, applyErr
127	}
128	
129	func recoverConnectionReceipt(record serverConnection, stateDir string) (string, error) {
130		if record.ReceiptID != "" {
131			return record.ReceiptID, nil
132		}
133		entries, err := os.ReadDir(stateDir)
134		if err != nil {
135			return "", errors.New("import outcome is unknown and no receipt is available; inspect the client source before another import")
136		}
137		var candidate string
138		for _, entry := range entries {
139			if !entry.IsDir() {
140				continue
141			}
142			path := filepath.Join(stateDir, entry.Name(), "receipt.json")
143			info, err := os.Lstat(path)
144			if err != nil {
145				continue
146			}
147			if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || !privatefs.Private(path) || info.Size() > 1<<20 {
148				continue
149			}
150			data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
151			if err != nil {
152				continue
153			}
154			var receipt configwork.Receipt
155			if json.Unmarshal(data, &receipt) != nil {
156				continue
157			}
158			if receipt.ID != entry.Name() || receipt.TargetID != record.TargetID || receipt.Binding != record.Binding || receipt.CreatedAt.Before(record.StartedAt) {
159				continue
160			}
161			if candidate != "" {
162				return "", errors.New("multiple client import receipts found; inspect the saved receipts before retrying")
163			}
164			candidate = receipt.ID
165		}
166		if candidate == "" {
167			return "", errors.New("import outcome is unknown and no matching receipt is available; inspect the client source before another import")
168		}
169		return candidate, nil
170	}
```

## 建議定位

新增頂層 **`lazyclash doctor`**。目前的 `proxy docker doctor`、`analytics doctor` 都不是整體本機代理診斷；`proxy status` 最接近，但解析失敗時不會輸出已收集的環境資訊。

首版只做**被動本機診斷**：讀取環境、設定、OS metadata，以及本機 controller 的 `GET /version`、`GET /configs`。不自動修復、不測外網、不驗證代理出口、不啟動 SSH／服務，也不加入 TUI 或 cloud 功能。

## 實作步驟

### 1. 建立獨立報告與聚合層

新增 `/Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/lazyclash/internal/doctor/run.go`，提供 `Run(ctx, request, options)`；CLI 僅負責參數、呈現與退出碼。

- 報告包含版本、檢查範圍、選取來源、檢查結果、摘要與後續建議。
- 每項結果使用穩定 ID、`pass / warn / fail / unknown / skip`、原因碼及經過遮蔽的 evidence。
- `unknown` 表示證據不足；`skip` 表示不適用或刻意未執行，不能當成成功。
- 各檢查獨立完成；設定損壞、認證失敗或 controller 離線，不得丟失環境與 OS 結果。
- 注入環境讀取、discovery、controller opening、OS inspection、clock，方便離線測試。

使用獨立 `internal/doctor`，不要把聚合放進 `diagnostics`；日後若引用 `managedcore` 才不會形成循環依賴。**首版不需要 managedcore lifecycle/status 聚合**：`GetStatus` 會吞掉部分 controller 錯誤，亦超出必要範圍。

### 2. 分開「選取目標」與「讀取 runtime」

在 `/Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/lazyclash/internal/proxyenv/resolve.go` 小幅抽取可共用的選取邏輯與 runtime-to-plan helper，保留現有 `Resolve` 公開行為。

- 維持 explicit target／endpoint、`LOCAL_PROXY_URL`、本機 default、discovery 的順序。
- 保留 ambiguity，不挑第一個、不彈出 picker。
- doctor 選定本機 controller 後，以 `connection.Open(..., true)` 驗證 identity／credentials，再讀一次 `/configs`；該 snapshot 同時供報告與 endpoint 比對使用。
- 不直接串接 `diagnostics.Test` 與 `Resolve`：前者丟棄 configs，容易造成重複請求且難保留分階段結果。
- settings 使用 `settingsPath` 加 `config.Load`，不要直接沿用 `o.load` 的 fail-fast usage error。預設設定檔不存在不等於設定損壞；指定檔案不存在或 TOML 無效則是報告中的 failure。

### 3. 在探測前限制本機範圍

針對 `/Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/lazyclash/internal/connection/discovery.go` 增加 doctor 可用的 local-only discovery 路徑，共用既有候選收集邏輯。

**必須在 `probeBatch` 前過濾**，不能只過濾 `Discover` 的回傳結果；目前本機設定檔中的 controller URL 仍可能指向遠端。

- 只接受無 SSH 的 loopback／Unix controller。
- 明確指定遠端 target 或 `--ssh`：保留本機環境報告，標示選取範圍不適用／診斷未完成；不開 SSH、不偷偷改選本機。
- 遠端 data endpoint 可以作為環境中的觀察值，但不能推定它屬於本機 core。
- 零 discovery 結果只能說「未辨識到 controller」，不能證明沒有代理。

### 4. 收集與判讀最小必要證據

| 檢查 | 首版行為 |
|---|---|
| Process environment | HTTP／HTTPS／ALL_PROXY 大小寫變數、NO_PROXY 是否設定；標示只有目前 process 的視角 |
| OS proxy | 重用 `networkcheck.ReadSystemProxy(ctx, "", nil)` 的 typed snapshot；明確處理 unavailable，不用會吞錯的 `proxyenv.SystemProxy` |
| Settings／selection | 載入結果、來源、候選歧義、是否為本機 |
| Controller／runtime | identity、認證、configs 可讀性；僅保留 mode、必要 ports、bind、TUN 等允許欄位 |
| Endpoint consistency | 比對同一 scope 的環境／OS endpoint 與 runtime；差異通常是 warning，不直接宣告代理故障 |
| Host network | 重用 `InspectWithOptions` 的 capability 與必要 TUN／routing 證據，不輸出完整 inventory |

重要判讀規則：

- macOS snapshot 是**各 network service 的設定**，不代表每個 service 都正在使用；Linux GNOME 設定也不代表全系統。
- `networkcheck.Analyze` 的 `existing-core-tun`、VPN routing conflict 是「啟用另一個 TUN 前」的警告，不能直接轉成 doctor failure。
- TUN-only、未設定環境 proxy、`mode=direct` 本身都不是故障。
- 明確輸出「出口連通性未測試」，建議使用既有 `proxy test` 或 `diagnostics` 指令。

### 5. CLI、JSON 與退出碼

新增 `/Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/lazyclash/internal/cli/doctor.go`，在 `/Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/lazyclash/internal/cli/root.go` 註冊。

介面維持簡單：`doctor`、`doctor --json`、本機 `--target`／`--controller`、可選 `--endpoint` 與 `--timeout`。永不互動，`--read-only` 可正常使用。

建議退出契約：

- **0**：無 failure，必要檢查完成；允許 warning、可選資訊 unknown，以及刻意跳過的外網測試。
- **1**：有 failure，或歧義／timeout／非本機選取造成必要診斷未完成。
- **2**：CLI 語法或互斥參數錯誤。
- **130**：取消；仍盡可能輸出已收集的報告。

在 `/Users/zhouhanru/Documents/David/Program/lazyclash/internal/cli/execute.go` 增加窄範圍的「報告已輸出」typed outcome 處理：先成功寫完報告，再回傳退出狀態；process boundary 不再額外印一份 error envelope。一般錯誤與其他命令的既有退出碼維持不變。輸出 writer 失敗則仍走普通錯誤流程。

## 邊界與測試

- **時間限制**：建議整體預設 10 秒，controller／OS helper 各有較短 deadline；覆蓋現有 inspection 的 40 秒上限。取消要傳至 helper／HTTP，並關閉 client、closer。

```text
29	func execute(ctx context.Context, args []string, in io.Reader, out, errOut io.Writer, deps Dependencies) int {
30		cmd := New(deps)
31		cmd.SetArgs(append([]string{}, args...))
32		cmd.SetIn(in)
33		cmd.SetOut(out)
34		cmd.SetErr(errOut)
35		jsonMode := jsonRequested(cmd, args)
36		if err := cmd.ExecuteContext(ctx); err != nil {
37			if jsonMode {
38				encoder := json.NewEncoder(errOut)
39				encoder.SetEscapeHTML(false)
40				_ = encoder.Encode(errorEnvelope{Error: describeError(err)})
41			} else {
42				_, _ = fmt.Fprintln(errOut, "lazyclash:", core.Sanitize(err.Error()))
43			}
44			return ExitCode(err)
45		}
46		return 0
47	}

51	}

72		case errors.As(err, &usageErr), strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "unknown command "):

89			result.Code = "timeout"
```

```text
22	func Resolve(ctx context.Context, cfg config.Config, request Request, opts Options) (Plan, error) {
23		getenv := opts.Getenv
24		if getenv == nil {
25			getenv = os.Getenv
26		}
27		if request.Endpoint != "" {
28			if request.TargetID != "" {
29				return Plan{}, errors.New("use either --endpoint or --target")
30			}
31			return explicitPlan(request.Endpoint, request.SocksEndpoint, "explicit endpoint")
32		}
33		if request.SocksEndpoint != "" {
34			return Plan{}, errors.New("--socks-endpoint requires --endpoint")
35		}
36		if request.TargetID != "" {
37			for _, target := range cfg.Targets {
38				if target.ID == request.TargetID {
39					return resolveTarget(ctx, target, opts)
40				}
41			}
42			return Plan{}, errors.New("proxy target is not registered; use targets list")
43		}
44		if value := getenv("LOCAL_PROXY_URL"); value != "" {
45			return explicitPlan(value, getenv("LOCAL_PROXY_SOCKS_URL"), "LOCAL_PROXY_URL")
46		}
47		var local []config.Target
48		for _, target := range cfg.Targets {
49			if IsLocalTarget(target) {
50				local = append(local, target)
51			}
52		}
53		for _, target := range local {
54			if target.ID == cfg.DefaultTarget {
55				return resolveTarget(ctx, target, opts)
56			}
57		}
58		if len(local) == 0 {
59			discover := opts.Discover
60			if discover == nil {
61				discover = connection.Discover
62			}
63			var err error
64			local, err = discover(ctx, "")
65			if err != nil {
66				return Plan{}, err
67			}
68		}
69		if len(local) == 0 {
70			return Plan{}, ErrNoProxyConfigured
71		}
72		if len(local) > 1 {
73			return Plan{}, &AmbiguousError{Targets: local}
74		}
75		return resolveTarget(ctx, local[0], opts)
76	}

93	func explicitPlan(endpoint, socks, source string) (Plan, error) {
94		if endpoint == "" {

106				return Plan{}, errors.New("SOCKS endpoint must use socks5 or socks5h")
107			}
108		} else {
109			socks = endpoint
110		}
111		return Plan{HTTP: endpoint, All: socks, Source: source}, nil
```

```text
# Public IP addresses in Azure - Azure Virtual Network | Microsoft Learn

Public IP addresses allow Internet resources to communicate inbound to Azure resources. Public IP addresses enable Azure resources to communicate to internet and public-facing Azure services. For your Azure resources which are associated with public IP addresses, these public IPs remain dedicated exclusively to the resource until you unassign it or delete the resource.

A resource without an assigned public IP can still communicate outbound; in these instances, Azure automatically assigns an available dynamic IP address for outbound communication. This dynamically assigned address isn't dedicated to the resource and can change over time. For more information about outbound connections in Azure, see [Understand outbound connections](../../load-balancer/load-balancer-outbound-connections?toc=/azure/virtual-network/toc.json).

In Azure Resource Manager, a [public IP](virtual-network-public-ip-address) address is a resource that has its own properties.

The following resources can be associated with a public IP address:

- Virtual machine network interfaces
- Virtual Machine Scale Sets
- Azure Load Balancers (public)
- Virtual Network Gateways (VPN/ER)
- NAT gateways
- Application Gateways
- Azure Firewalls
- Bastion Hosts
- Route Servers
- API Management

For Virtual Machine Scale Sets, use [Public IP Prefixes](public-ip-address-prefix).

## At-a-glance

The following table shows the property a public IP can be associated to a resource and the allocation methods. Public IPv6 support isn't available for all resource types at this time.

| Top-level resource | IP Address association | Dynamic IPv4 | Static IPv4 | Dynamic IPv6 | Static IPv6 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Virtual machine | Network interface | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Public Load balancer | Front-end configuration | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Virtual Network gateway (VPN) | Gateway IP configuration | Yes (non-AZ only) | Yes | No | No |
| Virtual Network gateway (ER) | Gateway IP configuration | Yes | Yes | Yes (preview) | No |
| NAT gateway | Gateway IP configuration | No | Yes | No | No |
| Application Gateway | Front-end configuration | Yes (V1 only) | Yes (V2 only) | No | No |
| Azure Firewall | Front-end configuration | No | Yes | No | No |
| Bastion Host | Public IP configuration | No | Yes | No | No |
| Route Server | Front-end configuration | No | Yes | No | No |
| API Management | Front-end configuration | No | Yes | No | No |

## IP address version

Public IP addresses can be created with an IPv4 or IPv6 address. You may be given the option to create a dual-stack deployment with a IPv4 and IPv6 address.

## SKU

Important

On September 30, 2025, Basic SKU public IPs were retired. For more information, see the [official announcement](https://azure.microsoft.com/updates/upgrade-to-standard-sku-public-ip-addresses-in-azure-by-30-september-2025-basic-sku-will-be-retired/). If you are currently using Basic SKU public IPs, make sure to upgrade to Standard SKU as soon as possible. For guidance on upgrading, visit [Upgrading a basic public IP address to Standard SKU - Guidance](public-ip-basic-upgrade-guidance).

Public IP addresses can created with a SKU of **Standard (v1 or v2)** or **Basic**. The SKU determines their functionality including allocation method, feature support, and resources they can be associated with.

Full details are listed in the table below:

| Public IP address | Standard (v1 or v2) | Basic |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Allocation method | Static | For IPv4: Dynamic or Static; For IPv6: Dynamic. |
| Idle Timeout | Have an adjustable inbound originated flow idle timeout of 4-30 minutes, with a default of 4 minutes, and fixed outbound originated flow idle timeout of 4 minutes. | Have an adjustable inbound originated flow idle timeout of 4-30 minutes, with a default of 4 minutes, and fixed outbound originated flow idle timeout of 4 minutes. |
| Security | Secure by default model and be closed to inbound traffic when used as a frontend. Allow traffic with [network security group (NSG)](../network-security-groups-overview#network-security-groups) is required (for example, on the NIC of a virtual machine with a Standard SKU Public IP attached). | Open by default. Network security groups are recommended but optional for restricting inbound or outbound traffic. |
| [Availability zones](/en-us/azure/reliability/availability-zones-overview?toc=%2fazure%2fvirtual-network%2ftoc.json) | Supported. Standard IPs can be non-zonal, zonal, or zone-redundant. Standard v2 IPs can only be zone-redundant. **Zone redundant IPs can only be created in [regions where 3 availability zones](/en-us/azure/reliability/availability-zones-region-support) are live.** | Not supported. |
| [Routing preference Internet](routing-preference-overview) | Standard: Supported for use with [specific resource types](routing-preference-overview#supported-services) for more granular control on how traffic is routed between Azure and the Internet.Standardv2: Not supported | Not supported. |
| Global tier | Standard: Supported for use with [cross-region load balancers](../../load-balancer/cross-region-overview).Standardv2: Not yet supported | Not supported. |

Virtual machines attached to a backend pool don't need a public IP address to be attached to a public load balancer. But if they do, matching SKUs are required for load balancer and public IP resources. You can't have a mixture of basic SKU resources and standard SKU resources. You can't attach standalone virtual machines, virtual machines in an availability set resource, or a virtual machine scale set resources to both SKUs simultaneously. New designs should consider using Standard SKU resources. For more information about a standard load balancer, see [Standard Load Balancer](../../load-balancer/load-balancer-overview?toc=/azure/virtual-network/toc.json).

Important

Standard v2 IPs can only be utilized with the Standard v2 NAT GW product at this time. **It cannot be used with any other product or component.**

## IP address assignment

Public IPs have two types of assignments:

- **Dynamic** - The IP address **isn't** given to the resource at the time of creation when selecting dynamic. The IP is assigned when you associate the public IP address with a resource. The IP address is released when you stop, or delete the resource. Dynamic public IP addresses are commonly used for when there's no dependency on the IP address. For example, a public IP resource is released from a VM upon stop and then start. Any associated IP address is released if the allocation method is **dynamic**. If you don't want the IP address to change, set the allocation method to **static** to ensure the IP address remains the same.
- **Static** - The resource is assigned an IP address at the time it's created. The IP address is released when the resource is deleted and can't be recovered. When you set the allocation method to **static**, you can't specify the actual IP address assigned to the public IP address resource. Azure assigns the IP address from a pool of available IP addresses in the Azure location the resource is created in.

Static public IP addresses are commonly used in the following scenarios:

- When you must update firewall rules to communicate with your Azure resources.
- DNS name resolution, where a change in IP address would require updating A records.
- Your Azure resources communicate with other apps or services that use an IP address-based security model.
- You use TLS/SSL certificates linked to an IP address.

| Resource | Static | Dynamic |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard public IPv4 | ✅ | x |
| Standard public IPv6 | ✅ | x |
| Basic public IPv4 | ✅ | ✅ |
| Basic public IPv6 | x | ✅ |

## Availability Zone

Important

All formerly Standard non-zonal IPs [are now zone-redundant](https://azure.microsoft.com/blog/azure-public-ips-are-now-zone-redundant-by-default/) in all regions that support availability zones. The means that IPs that show as either "zones 1 2 3" or have no zones are equivalently zone-redundant.

Standard v2 SKU Public IPs are always created as zone-redundant in [regions that support availability zones](/en-us/azure/reliability/availability-zones-region-support). Standard SKU Public IPs can be created as zonal or zone-redundant in [regions that support availability zones](/en-us/azure/reliability/availability-zones-region-support). Basic SKU Public IPs don't have any zones and are created as non-zonal. Once created, a public IP address can't change its availability zone.

In regions without availability zones, all public IP addresses are created as non-zonal. Public IP addresses created in a region that is later upgraded to have availability zones will be made zone-redundant once the region is in general availability status with multiple availability zones.

| Value | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Zone-redundant | A zone-redundant IP is created in multiple zones for a given region and can survive any single zone failure. |
| Zonal | A zonal IP is tied to a specific availability zone, and shares fate with the health of the zone. |
| Non-zonal | Only valid in regions that do not support availability zones. |

## Domain Name Label

Select this option to specify a DNS label for a public IP resource. This functionality works for both IPv4 addresses (32-bit A records) and IPv6 addresses (128-bit AAAA records). This selection creates a mapping for **domainnamelabel**.**location**.cloudapp.azure.com to the public IP in the Azure-managed DNS.

For instance, creation of a public IP with the following settings:

- **contoso** as a **domainnamelabel**
- **West US** Azure **location**

The fully qualified domain name (FQDN) **contoso.westus.cloudapp.azure.com** resolves to the public IP address of the resource. Each domain name label created must be unique within its Azure location.

If a custom domain is desired for services that use a public IP, you can use [Azure DNS](../../dns/dns-custom-domain?toc=/azure/virtual-network/toc.json#public-ip-address) or an external DNS provider for your DNS Record.

## Domain Name Label Scope (preview)

Public IPs also have an optional parameter for **Domain Name Label Scope**, which defines what domain label an object with the same name uses. This feature can help to prevent "dangling DNS names" which can be reused by malicious actors. When this option is chosen, the public IP address' DNS name has another string in between the **domainnamelabel** and **location** fields, for example, **contoso.fjdng2acavhkevd8.westus.cloudapp.Azure.com**. (This string is a hash generated from input specific to your subscription, resource group, domain name label, and other properties).

The domain name label scope can only be specified at the creation of a public IP address.

Important

Domain Name Label Scope is currently in public preview. It's provided without a service-level agreement, and is not recommended for production workloads. For more information, see [Supplemental Terms of Use for Microsoft Azure Previews](https://azure.microsoft.com/support/legal/preview-supplemental-terms/).

The value of the **Domain Name Label Scope** must match one of the options below:

| Value | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| TenantReuse | Object with the same name in the same tenant receives the same Domain Label |
| SubscriptionReuse | Object with the same name in the same subscription receives the same Domain Label |
| ResourceGroupReuse | Object with the same name in the same Resource Group receives the same Domain Label |
| NoReuse | Object with the same name receives a new Domain Label for each new instance |

For example, if **SubscriptionReuse** is selected as the option, and a customer who has the example domain name label **contoso.fjdng2acavhkevd8.westus.cloudapp.Azure.com** deletes and redeploys a public IP address using the same template as before, the domain name label remains the same. If the customer deploys a public IP address using this same template under a different subscription, the domain name label would change (for example, **contoso.c9ghbqhhbxevhzg9.westus.cloudapp.Azure.com**).

## Other public IP address features

There are other attributes that can be used for a public IP address (Standard SKU only).

- The Global **Tier** option creates a global anycast IP that can be used with cross-region load balancers.
- The Internet **Routing Preference** option minimizes the time that traffic spends on the Microsoft network, lowering the egress data transfer cost.

## Limits

The limits for IP addressing are listed in the full set of [limits for networking](../../azure-resource-manager/management/azure-subscription-service-limits?toc=/azure/virtual-network/toc.json#azure-networking-limits) in Azure. The limits are per region and per subscription.

[Contact support](https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Support/HelpAndSupportBlade) to increase above the default limits based on your business needs.

## Pricing

Public IPv4 addresses have a nominal charge; Public IPv6 addresses have no charge.

To learn more about IP address pricing in Azure, review the [IP address pricing](https://azure.microsoft.com/pricing/details/ip-addresses) page.

## Limitations for IPv6

- VPN gateways can't be used in a virtual network with IPv6 enabled, either directly or peered with "UseRemoteGateway".
- Azure doesn't support IPv6 communication for containers.
- Use of IPv6-only virtual machines or virtual machines scale sets aren't supported. Each NIC must include at least one IPv4 IP configuration (dual-stack).
- IPv6 ranges can't be added to a virtual network with existing resource navigation links when adding IPv6 to existing IPv4 deployments.
- Forward DNS for IPv6 is supported for Azure public DNS. Reverse DNS isn't supported.
- Routing Preference Internet isn't supported.

For more information on IPv6 in Azure, see [here](ipv6-overview).
```

89	
90	Use guided choice to remove syntax memorization, not to ask every possible flag.

```text
102	// Discover only reads runtime configuration and probes GET /version. It never
103	// falls back during Open of an explicitly chosen target. A 401 is exposed as an
104	// authentication-needed candidate, not mistaken for a usable controller.
105	func Discover(ctx context.Context, sshHost string) ([]config.Target, error) {
106		if sshHost != "" {
107			return discoverRemote(ctx, sshHost)
108		}
109		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
110		if err != nil {
111			return nil, errors.New("cannot locate home directory for local discovery")
112		}
113		paths := knownPaths(home, os.Getenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME"), os.Getenv("XDG_DATA_HOME"))
114		psCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 2*time.Second)
115		ps, _ := commandContext(psCtx, "ps", "-axo", "pid=,command=").Output()
116		cancel()
117		paths = uniquePaths(append(processConfigPaths(string(ps)), paths...))
118		var candidates []config.Target
119		for _, path := range paths {
120			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
121				return nil, err
122			}
123			data, err := readLimitedFile(path, maxConfigBytes)
124			if err != nil {
125				continue
126			}
127			runtime, err := parseRuntime(data)
128			if err != nil {
129				continue
130			}
131			for _, endpoint := range runtime.controllers() {
132				t := candidate(endpoint, path, "", runtime)
133				if runtime.complete() {
134					t.Configs = append(t.Configs, config.CoreConfig{ID: "runtime", Name: "Runtime YAML", Path: path})
135				}
136				t.Configs = append(t.Configs, localProfiles(filepath.Dir(path))...)
137				candidates = append(candidates, t)
138			}
139		}
140		for _, endpoint := range processListeners(ctx, "", string(ps)) {
141			candidates = append(candidates, candidate(endpoint, "", "", runtimeConfig{}))
142		}
143		return probeCandidates(ctx, candidates, ""), ctx.Err()
144	}
145	
146	func candidate(endpoint, path, sshHost string, runtime runtimeConfig) config.Target {
147		hash := sha256.Sum256([]byte(sshHost + "\x00" + endpoint))
148		name := endpoint
149		if path != "" {
150			name = filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(path)) + " · " + endpoint
151		}
152		if sshHost != "" {
153			name = sshHost + " · " + name
154		}
155		return config.Target{ID: "core-" + hex.EncodeToString(hash[:4]), Name: name, Controller: endpoint, SSHHost: sshHost, SourceConfig: path, Secret: runtime.Secret}
156	}
157	
158	func probeCandidates(ctx context.Context, candidates []config.Target, sshHost string) []config.Target {
159		// Source-backed and process-owned endpoints retain priority. The two known
160		// defaults get independent empty credentials and never borrow another core's.
161		seen := map[string]bool{}
162		for _, t := range candidates {
163			seen[t.Controller] = true
164		}
165		for _, port := range []string{"9090", "9097"} {
166			endpoint := "http://127.0.0.1:" + port
167			if !seen[endpoint] {
168				candidates = append(candidates, candidate(endpoint, "", sshHost, runtimeConfig{}))
169			}
170		}
171		return probeBatch(ctx, candidates)
172	}
173	
174	func probeBatch(ctx context.Context, candidates []config.Target) []config.Target {
175		// Keep deterministic configuration order even when probes finish out of order.
176		results := make([]*config.Target, len(candidates))
177		limit := make(chan struct{}, 4)
178		var wg sync.WaitGroup
179		for i, t := range candidates {
180			if ctx.Err() != nil {
181				break
182			}
183			wg.Add(1)
184			go func(i int, t config.Target) {
185				defer wg.Done()
186				select {
187				case limit <- struct{}{}:
188				case <-ctx.Done():
189					return
190				}
191				defer func() { <-limit }()
192				probeCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 3*time.Second)
193				defer cancel()
194				// Discovery already read the candidate's source. Open's ordinary path
195				// re-reads it later so saved targets never retain stale credentials.
196				probeTarget := t
197				probeTarget.SourceConfig = ""
198				_, closer, err := Open(probeCtx, probeTarget, true)
199				if err != nil {
200					var coreErr *core.Error
201					if errors.As(err, &coreErr) && coreErr.Kind == core.KindAuth {
202						t.AuthRequired = true
203						results[i] = &t
204					}
205					return
206				}
207				defer closer.Close()
208				results[i] = &t
209			}(i, t)
210		}
211		wg.Wait()
212		byEndpoint := map[string]int{}
213		var found []config.Target
214		for _, result := range results {
215			if result == nil {
216				continue
217			}
218			t := *result
219			key := t.SSHHost + "\x00" + t.Controller
220			if prior, ok := byEndpoint[key]; ok {
221				if found[prior].AuthRequired && !t.AuthRequired {
222					found[prior] = t
223				}
224				continue
225			}
226			byEndpoint[key] = len(found)
227			found = append(found, t)
228		}
229		return found
230	}
```

````markdown
## A. 新增 `lazyclash doctor`

### 互動與輸出契約

- 一次性 CLI：`lazyclash doctor`、`doctor --json`、`--target LOCAL doctor`、`--controller LOOPBACK doctor`；新增 `--timeout`，預設整體 10 秒。
- 預設本機、非互動、被動檢查。允許 controller GET 及本機 metadata；不發送外網測試、不呼叫 URLTest／healthcheck、不寫設定、不開 SSH、不啟動或修復服務，不改 TUN／系統代理／selector。
- 人類輸出為簡短分項檢查與具體下一步；JSON 為單一 typed report，含 schema version、scope、selection、checks、summary、建議。
- 項目狀態為 `pass / warn / fail / unknown / skip`。部分檢查失敗仍輸出其餘結果；明確標註「出口連通性未測試」。
- 退出碼：0 = 主要檢查完成且無 failure（允許 warning／可選 unknown）；1 = failure 或主要診斷未完成；2 = CLI 用法錯誤；130 = 取消。設定损壞屬診斷報告中的 failure，不在收集前直接退出。

### 實作步驟與關鍵檔案

1. **新增 `internal/doctor/run.go` 及測試**：共享聚合服務、typed report、可注入 collectors；避免放進 `diagnostics` 導致日後與 `managedcore` 循環引用。首版不整合服務 lifecycle，也不新增 TUI。
2. **設定與目標獨立處理**：使用 `config.Load`（`internal/config/config.go`），區別不存在的預設設定／明確指定檔案缺失／格式錯誤；環境與 OS 檢查不依赖設定載入成功。
   - 重用 `internal/proxyenv/resolve.go` 的 `IsLocalTarget`、local-default／單一候選／ambiguity 規則；必要時小幅抽取 selection 及 runtime endpoint helper，維持現有 `Resolve` 行為。
   - 分開 controller 身分與 data endpoint 的來源／優先序（包含 `LOCAL_PROXY_URL`），不能因 controller 離線就斷言代理 data path 故障。
   - 顯式遠端 target／SSH 不被偷換成本機：保留本機報告並標示 scope 不適用，不執行遠端連線。

4. **收集與判讀證據**：
   - 重用 `proxyenv.EnvironmentStatus`（`internal/proxyenv/probe.go`）取得已遮蔽的 process proxy variables。
   - 重用 `networkcheck.ReadSystemProxy`（`internal/networkcheck/system_proxy.go`）的 typed availability；macOS service 設定不代表每個 service 正在使用，unsupported 不等於 disabled。
   - 使用 `connection.Open(..., true)` 與一次 `/configs` snapshot 讀 controller identity、mode、ports、TUN；避免串接兩次 resolver／diagnostics.Test 重複請求。
   - 重用 `networkcheck.InspectWithOptions`（`internal/networkcheck/inspect.go`）的 capability 與必要介面／路由／DNS 證據，不搬入「新增 TUN 前」的整套 failure 判斷。
   - 比較同 scope 的 OS/env endpoint 與 runtime；不一致通常是 warning，不推定 ownership。TUN-only、無 proxy env、direct mode 本身均非故障。
   - 所有 collectors 有 bounded timeout／context cancellation，關閉 clients/helpers；不輸出 raw target、完整 config、PAC query、token、密碼或未遮蔽錯誤。
5. **新增 `internal/cli/doctor.go`**：薄 handler、human/JSON rendering；在 `internal/cli/root.go` 註冊並沿用既有 flag 驗證與 color/output 慣例。
   - `internal/cli/execute.go`／`root.go` 加窄範圍 typed reported outcome：報告成功輸出後才能帶非零 exit，不再印第二個 error envelope；其他命令退出與 error 契約不變。
6. **文件**：更新 `README.md`、`docs/diagnostics-and-routing.md`、必要的 embedded operating guide，説明 doctor 與主動測試的差別，以及現有 scoped doctors。

## B. 用既有 az-backed 流程實測香港 HY2

### 1. 再預檢與建立付費 VM

- 使用新 binary，重新驗證上述 user／tenant／subscription、報價、quota、ARM Ubuntu image、inventory ID 不衝突。指定 `Standard_B2pts_v2`、Ubuntu 24.04 ARM64 的 pinned image、32 GiB disk、native backend；若缺容量或價格提高，停止回報，不自動升級機型或換區域／帳號。
- 以本機已載入的 `id_ed25519.pub` 作 SSH 公鑰。建立前辨識實際 SSH 管理路徑的出口 IPv4，將 TCP 22 限於該 `/32`；TUN／既有代理會影響出口，不能把任何 IP 查詢結果直接當實體網路出口。無法確定時請使用者提供管理 CIDR，絕不默認全網 SSH。
- 先 preview，再展示精確帳號、成本、資源、SSH CIDR、digest；取得**此階段付費資源核准**後才 apply：

```sh
$LC vps create azure-hk-hy2 --provider azure \
  --subscription <AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID> \
  --region eastasia --plan Standard_B2pts_v2 --architecture arm64 \
  --disk-gb 32 --ssh-key "$HOME/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub" \
  --ssh-cidr "$ADMIN_CIDR" --json
# 以完全相同參數追加 --yes --expect "$VM_DIGEST"
```

- 使用 `internal/vps/azure*.go` 的既有 az adapter／owned resource group／operation receipts。只建立一台，不碰既有資源。現有 NSG 開 TCP 80/443 與 UDP 443；HY2 使用 UDP 443、ACME 使用 TCP 80，無需新增管理 UI、Bastion、NAT Gateway 或付費 DNS zone。
- 部分／不確定建立結果先 status/resume reconcile，不能重試建第二台。

### 2. DNS、SSH trust 與 HY2

- 推薦在**新 VM 所屬 public-IP resource**上透過 `az network public-ip update --dns-name ... --subscription ...` 設唯一 Azure DNS label，讀回真實 `dnsSettings.fqdn`（通常 `LABEL.eastasia.cloudapp.azure.com`）。不需購買 domain、不猜測 FQDN；驗證公開 A／AAAA 正確。
- DNS 名稱及公開憑證會公開（包含 Certificate Transparency），於部署審核中説明。若 Azure hostname 的 ACME 簽發受限，停止處理再選可控 hostname；不用 self-signed 或 skip-cert-verify 繞過。
- SSH host key 經 Azure 已驗證控制面／console 比對後才加入 known_hosts；不使用 `StrictHostKeyChecking=no` 或僅信任未驗證的 ssh-keyscan。
- 確認 Ubuntu 24.04、sudo -n、Python/systemd、port binding／防火牆／DNS／ACME 前提。沿用 `internal/serverdeploy` 預檢与 receipt：

```sh
$LC servers deploy hy2-hk --host azure-hk-hy2 \
  --recipe hysteria2 --backend native \
  --public-host "$VM_IP" --domain "$AZURE_FQDN" --obfs none --json
# 審核後，以相同參數追加 --yes --expect "$SERVER_DIGEST"
```

- 首次不加 obfuscation／進階調優。省略可選 ACME email，避免不必要個資登記。確認 certbot.timer 與 renewal hook；TCP 80 保持可供續期。
- `internal/serverprobe/probe.go` 既有 isolated Mihomo 必須得到 authenticated HTTPS 成功與觀察到的 VM 出口。不得只根據 systemd running 或 exit 0 宣稱成功；`installed-unverified` 要如實處理。
- 本機既有 TUN 可能造成巢狀代理：查看 routes，必要時用既有 `--verify-interface` 指定經確認的實體介面；不為測試關掉現在的代理。區分端到端 HY2 成功與「本機直接到香港」已證實。
- 只做少量功能請求，不做大流量 benchmark；網路擋 UDP 時保留具體證據，不盲目加大 VM。

### 3. 本機匯入，與切換流量分離

- 顯式 target `local-clash-verge-rev`，重查 `configs source show`、Verge 當前 profile UID 與 selector，不能只信舊 registration；source binding 不一致則先停止，不直接改生成的 runtime YAML。
- HY2 獨立驗證通過後，透過既有 `servers connect`／`configwork` preview source diff、backup／receipt。新建 `HY2-Test` 群組，不更動父群組、rules 或現在 selection：

```sh
$LC --target local-clash-verge-rev servers connect hy2-hk \
  --create-group HY2-Test --json
# 説明 reload 的影響並取得本機寫入核准，再追加 --yes --expect "$CLIENT_DIGEST"
$LC --target local-clash-verge-rev servers connect hy2-hk --verify --json
```

- 匯入可能 reload；不能承諾完全無流量影響。unowned Verge 若回 `persisted_pending_owner_reload`，由使用者在 Verge 重載正確 profile 再驗證，不擅自繞過 owner。
- 驗證節點存在、source/runtime 一致、憑證與 node test 成功；不自動切換目前主代理。使用者另行要求切流量時才審核目標群組／成員並保留原 selection。
- 最後用 doctor 再檢查本機狀態，回報 VM identity/IP/FQDN、server verification、匯入／activation 狀態及仍未驗證事項；不印 client credentials。

### 4. 回復與費用收尾

- 分別保留 VM、server、client 的 receipts／可恢復狀態；不能把 timeout 視為沒有寫入。
- Client 回復用 configwork 原生 restore／verify，不覆寫整份 Verge 設定。
- 預設保留已建立的 VM 供使用，清楚告知持續費用；不擅自刪除。使用者選擇刪除時，先移除本次 client/server 關聯，再按 owned-resource preview 刪除本次 VM/disk/IP，確認實際資源均消失；deallocate 不等於清零費用。
- 正式雲端操作前跑相關 `./internal/vps ./internal/serverdeploy ./internal/serverprobe ./internal/configwork ./internal/cli` 測試。付費香港 VM、ACME/systemd 與本機真實代理的驗收要分開記錄，unit tests 不能替代。
````

````text
## Context

使用者希望一個指令診斷當前本機代理，並在 Hanru 的 Azure 帳號建立最低實用規格的香港 VM，試跑 Hysteria 2（HY2）後配置到本機。

目前沒有頂層 `doctor`；已有 `proxy status`、`diagnostics network`、`targets test`、目的地診斷，以及 Docker／analytics 的局部 doctor。新增的是唯讀總覽，不重寫這些診斷能力。Azure 建置、HY2 原生部署、獨立驗證及 client import 已存在，優先用現成流程，不新增一套部署工具。

### 已完成的唯讀調查

- 本機 target `local-clash-verge-rev` 的 controller `127.0.0.1:9097` 可讀，Mihomo `v1.19.32`；mixed port 7897、rule mode、TUN `utun8` 啟用。macOS HTTP／HTTPS／SOCKS 均指向 `127.0.0.1:7897`；目前 process 沒有 proxy env。尚未驗證外網或 HY2。
- 全域預設 target 是遠端 `david-ubuntu`，不能把它當作本機。
- 安裝中的 lazyclash 是 `v0.1.12`，不同於目前 checkout；執行新功能與部署時使用從此 checkout 建置的獨立 binary，不直接覆寫 Homebrew 安裝。
- `~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub` 指紋與目前 ssh-agent 中 Hanru 的 key 相符；不需新建 key，不讀取／輸出 private key。

### 香港即時零售報價（2026-11-01 本地時間）

以下均含 32 GiB Standard SSD 與 Standard static IPv4，以每月 730 小時計，不扣訂閱 credit／共用免費額度：

| SKU | CPU / RAM | 固定 USD/月 |
| --- | --- | ---: |
| **Standard_B2pts_v2（推薦，ARM64）** | 2 vCPU / 1 GiB | **14.518** |
| Standard_B2ats_v2 | 2 vCPU / 1 GiB | 15.613 |
| Standard_B1s | 1 vCPU / 1 GiB | 16.708 |
| Standard_B2ts_v2 | 2 vCPU / 1 GiB | 16.708 |

推薦規格的 compute 8.468 + disk 2.40 + IPv4 3.65 = **約 US$14.52/月**。Deallocate 後 disk/IP 仍約 **US$6.05/月**；磁碟交易、稅及出站流量另計。第一個付費流量級距 US$0.12/GB；API 列出的 100 GB 是共用額度，不保證尚有可用餘額。0.5 GiB 的 B1ls 不符合現有部署選擇器最低 1 GiB 要求。這是已比較的相容小型 SKU 中最低價，不宣稱 Azure 所有 SKU 的絕對最低價。

$LC servers deploy hy2-hk --host azure-hk-hy2 \
  --recipe hysteria2 --backend native \
  --public-host "$VM_IP" --domain "$AZURE_FQDN" --obfs none --json
# 審核後，以相同參數追加 --yes --expect "$SERVER_DIGEST"
```

- 首次不加 obfuscation／進階調優。省略可選 ACME email，避免不必要個資登記。確認 certbot.timer 與 renewal hook；TCP 80 保持可供續期。
- `internal/serverprobe/probe.go` 既有 isolated Mihomo 必須得到 authenticated HTTPS 成功與觀察到的 VM 出口。不得只根據 systemd running 或 exit 0 宣稱成功；`installed-unverified` 要如實處理。
- 本機既有 TUN 可能造成巢狀代理：查看 routes，必要時用既有 `--verify-interface` 指定經確認的實體介面；不為測試關掉現在的代理。區分端到端 HY2 成功與「本機直接到香港」已證實。
- 只做少量功能請求，不做大流量 benchmark；網路擋 UDP 時保留具體證據，不盲目加大 VM。

### 3. 本機匯入，與切換流量分離

- 顯式 target `local-clash-verge-rev`，重查 `configs source show`、Verge 當前 profile UID 與 selector，不能只信舊 registration；source binding 不一致則先停止，不直接改生成的 runtime YAML。
- HY2 獨立驗證通過後，透過既有 `servers connect`／`configwork` preview source diff、backup／receipt。新建 `HY2-Test` 群組，不更動父群組、rules 或現在 selection：

```sh
$LC --target local-clash-verge-rev servers connect hy2-hk \
  --create-group HY2-Test --json
# 説明 reload 的影響並取得本機寫入核准，再追加 --yes --expect "$CLIENT_DIGEST"
$LC --target local-clash-verge-rev servers connect hy2-hk --verify --json
```

- 匯入可能 reload；不能承諾完全無流量影響。unowned Verge 若回 `persisted_pending_owner_reload`，由使用者在 Verge 重載正確 profile 再驗證，不擅自繞過 owner。
- 驗證節點存在、source/runtime 一致、憑證與 node test 成功；不自動切換目前主代理。使用者另行要求切流量時才審核目標群組／成員並保留原 selection。
- 最後用 doctor 再檢查本機狀態，回報 VM identity/IP/FQDN、server verification、匯入／activation 狀態及仍未驗證事項；不印 client credentials。

### 4. 回復與費用收尾

- 分別保留 VM、server、client 的 receipts／可恢復狀態；不能把 timeout 視為沒有寫入。
- Client 回復用 configwork 原生 restore／verify，不覆寫整份 Verge 設定。
- 預設保留已建立的 VM 供使用，清楚告知持續費用；不擅自刪除。使用者選擇刪除時，先移除本次 client/server 關聯，再按 owned-resource preview 刪除本次 VM/disk/IP，確認實際資源均消失；deallocate 不等於清零費用。
- 正式雲端操作前跑相關 `./internal/vps ./internal/serverdeploy ./internal/serverprobe ./internal/configwork ./internal/cli` 測試。付費香港 VM、ACME/systemd 與本機真實代理的驗收要分開記錄，unit tests 不能替代。
````

# Go CLI / TUI

Build around **see → select → act → see the result**. Keep context visible,
common actions discoverable, and navigation responsive while work runs. These
are opinionated defaults for new tools and features; respect existing contracts.

## Boundaries and defaults

- Use for Go commands, dashboards, pickers, wizards, and interaction fixes.
  A one-shot picker need not become a full-screen dashboard.
- Prefer Cobra for a command tree; Bubble Tea, Bubbles, and Lip Gloss for TUI;
  Huh when a form earns its complexity. A tiny CLI can use `flag`. Retain a
  working framework in an existing project.
- Read `go.mod` before examples. For greenfield work, choose compatible stable
  Charm versions, verify Go requirements, and pin `go.mod`/`go.sum`.
- Lazygit's implementation is an in-tree gocui fork, not Bubble Tea. Borrow
  interaction principles without copying its Git actions, layout, or every key.
- This is a development skill, not a Lazygit usage guide or general Go tutorial.
  Release-channel work can use the optional
  [cli-release-distribution guide](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/agent-skills/tree/main/skills/local/cli-release-distribution).
  No other skill is required to use this package.

## Workflow

- [ ] **1. Ground the task.** Read the command tree, services, config, terminal
  setup, and tests. Identify the repeated task, necessary state, target OSes,
  and whether it needs a command, picker, wizard, or dashboard. For a distributed
  CLI, include its installation and upgrade paths in the interaction scope. Infer from the
  repo; ask only about consequential product choices that remain unknown.
- [ ] **2. Define the interaction.** Sketch the primary screen and one complete
  action path using the compact contract below. Record focus, keyboard behavior,
  entry conditions, and failure/cancel behavior before wiring widgets.
- [ ] **3. Build a vertical slice.** Connect a real operation from CLI and UI to
  the same domain service, validation, and result. Keep handlers and views thin;
  add packages as responsibilities grow, rather than generating empty layers.
- [ ] **4. Complete the states.** Handle loading, successful empty results,
  errors, refresh, cancellation, resize, and return from overlays or external
  programs. Add configuration for actual recurring preferences.
- [ ] **5. Verify and finish.** Run relevant checks, fix failures, and exercise
  the interaction in a PTY. Report changes, evidence, and untested paths.
  For a published CLI, verify how an existing installation reaches the next
  version; a successful fresh install alone does not cover that journey.
  Complete an authorized build request; do not stop after producing a design.

### Compact interaction contract

Use in working notes or the implementation explanation. Do not require a new
specification file for a small change; omit inapplicable rows.

```text
Task:           repeated action and state needed to decide
Surface:        command / inline picker / wizard / dashboard
Layout:         list, detail/preview, status; narrow-screen behavior
Navigation:     focus, arrows + Vim aliases, search, Back, help
Entry:          bare command, flags, --interactive, non-TTY/JSON
Operation:      shared service, validation, target, result, cancellation
State:          selection identity, async ownership, freshness, failure
Configuration:  preferences, paths, precedence, effective-config view
Acceptance:     input sequence and observable expected result
```

## Interaction invariants

1. **Stable context.** Keep pane roles, per-view selection, scroll, and filter.
   Refresh follows identity, not an old row number. Show focus separately from
   selection and status colors.
2. **Two navigation vocabularies.** Support arrows and `j/k`, Tab/Shift+Tab for
   focus, and context-appropriate `h/l`. Add `gg/G` for long lists. No required
   normal/insert mode. Advertise only applicable actions.
3. **Typing owns printable keys.** Route events through the modal and focused
   widget before navigation shortcuts. Typing `j`, `q`, `/`, or an action's
   mnemonic in a field must not invoke that action.
4. **Discoverable speed.** Provide a short contextual footer, `?` help, and an
   action menu when needed. Derive hints and dispatch from the same effective
   bindings and availability definitions.
5. **Immediate feedback.** Render available state before slow discovery; allow
   navigation during I/O. Show pending, success, and failure while retaining
   useful rows. Avoid decorative motion that competes with the task.
6. **Proportional confirmation.** Destructive actions name the exact target and
   consequence. Reversible navigation stays immediate. A mutating wizard ends
   with one meaningful review/submit step.

Read [interaction-design.md](references/interaction-design.md) when laying out
screens or implementing navigation, filtering, help, mouse behavior, or resize.

## CLI and wizard entry policy

Parse flags and validate syntax before deciding whether to prompt. Interactive
behavior follows intent, not merely the existence of a terminal.

| Invocation | Default |
|---|---|
| Bare app with a dashboard, interactive terminal | Open dashboard |
| Bare command explicitly designated wizard-capable, e.g. `create` | Open wizard |
| Bare ordinary command group | Show help |
| Partial business flags/arguments, required data missing | Usage error, example, help hint |
| Complete valid business flags/arguments | Execute command path |
| Explicit `--interactive` | Prefill from flags/config; collect remaining choices |
| Non-TTY or machine-output mode | Never prompt; produce data, help, or clear error |
| Invalid flag/value, even with `--interactive` | Report error; do not turn a typo into a wizard |

Global options such as `--config` and `--color` do not alone signal business
command intent. An explicit UI request without a usable TTY or combined with
JSON output is an error. Make equivalent operations scriptable; keep stdout
clean and diagnostics separate.

Read [cli-wizards-config.md](references/cli-wizards-config.md) for commands,
guided setup, validation, configuration, or shell integration.

## Implementation and verification references

- Read [charm-stack.md](references/charm-stack.md) when selecting dependencies,
  finding an existing component, or adapting version-sensitive examples. It maps
  needs to official libraries/tools; it is not a bulk-install instruction.
- Read [async-terminal.md](references/async-terminal.md) for background work,
  startup performance, or terminal handoffs. It includes dev-cli lessons with
  sources and performance evidence guidance.
- Read [agent-facing-cli.md](references/agent-facing-cli.md) when a tool needs
  an embedded operational skill or a dependable automation interface. Keep
  agent and human entry points on the same services; a bundled skill is optional.
- Read [go-distribution.md](references/go-distribution.md) when preparing a Go
  CLI for other users: start with the actual main-package install path, version
  reporting, published tags, and separate source/module packaging boundaries;
  add package managers when the release needs them.
- Read [shell-completion.md](references/shell-completion.md) for native generators,
  user install/status, fpath activation, offline candidates and real shell tests.
- Read [shell-context.md](references/shell-context.md) when exporting a parent-shell
  environment, owning persistent connections, or generating consumer configuration.
- Read [self-update.md](references/self-update.md) when making a CLI installable,
  preparing its first release, or adding an upgrade command.
  Choose source, release assets, or the owning package manager from evidence;
  verify the effective installed copy while preserving local builds by default.
- Read [verification.md](references/verification.md) before declaring an
  interaction implemented. Select applicable cases, use deterministic state
  tests, and exercise a real PTY; screenshots cannot prove input behavior.

## Installed-tool lifecycle

For a CLI with supported, versioned user installations, provide a discoverable
`upgrade` entry point and a read-only `upgrade --check` by default. Follow an
established equivalent command name when the project already has one. If the
product deliberately omits this entry point, record the reason and its supported
external upgrade path; do not leave it out simply because the task focused on
the dashboard. Experimental one-off programs need no release machinery.

An explicit upgrade should execute the supported owning package manager under
the CLI's normal confirmation policy. A recognized, supported Homebrew install
should not stop at printing `brew upgrade`. Keep manual guidance for unsupported
or ambiguous ownership. A small manager adapter is enough; this default does not
require adding a standalone downloader or compiler. When a manager requires the
running program to exit, expose an observable handoff and a final-result query;
accepted work is not completed work. Updating the CLI must remain
separate from updating its managed service, data, or configuration.

## Gotchas

- **Charm v1/v2 examples are not interchangeable.** Bubble Tea v2 uses
  `charm.land/bubbletea/v2`, `tea.KeyPressMsg`, and `View() tea.View`; v1 uses
  the older module, `tea.KeyMsg`, and `View() string`. Huh/Bubbles must match
  the model generation. A UX fix is not permission to migrate the app.
- **Async wrappers can still freeze startup.** Blocking constructors, config
  probes, first-frame work, or synchronous `Update`/`View` work block input.
  Move the actual slow work into effects.
- **Late results remain late after cancellation.** Correlate results with the
  current request before changing state. Cancelled waiting also does not prove
  a remote write was rolled back.
- **Bytes/runes are not terminal widths.** Use ANSI-aware cell measurement and
  grapheme-safe truncation; test Chinese, combining marks, and emoji. Clamp
  sizes after subtracting actual borders/padding, including tiny resizes.
- **A character device is not necessarily a TTY.** Detect the actual input and
  output terminals. Machine-output intent suppresses UI even with a TTY.
- **A flag default is not an explicit override.** Preserve changed-flag
  information for explicit `false`, `0`, and empty values. Cobra validation
  hooks can run before `RunE`; check ordering before expecting a wizard to fill
  a required flag.
- **`os.UserConfigDir()` does not enforce XDG everywhere.** macOS uses
  Application Support. Implement the chosen XDG policy explicitly; persistent
  state belongs outside both disposable cache and the preferences file.
- **Nested terminal readers compete.** Integrate a form into the current model
  or release/suspend the outer program before running another reader. Restore
  terminal modes before children/editors and on handled exit paths.

This package contains instructions and references, not a generator or starter.
Preferences are original synthesis; project observations and official contracts
are identified in the references.

21	
22	以下均含 32 GiB Standard SSD 與 Standard static IPv4，以每月 730 小時計，不扣訂閱 credit／共用免費額度：

24	| SKU | CPU / RAM | 固定 USD/月 |

31	推薦規格的 compute 8.468 + disk 2.40 + IPv4 3.65 = **約 US$14.52/月**。Deallocate 後 disk/IP 仍約 **US$6.05/月**；磁碟交易、稅及出站流量另計。第一個付費流量級距 US$0.12/GB；API 列出的 100 GB 是共用額度，不保證尚有可用餘額。0.5 GiB 的 B1ls 不符合現有部署選擇器最低 1 GiB 要求。這是已比較的相容小型 SKU 中最低價，不宣稱 Azure 所有 SKU 的絕對最低價。
32	
33	## A. 新增 `lazyclash doctor`
34	
35	### 互動與輸出契約
36	
37	- 一次性 CLI：`lazyclash doctor`、`doctor --json`、`--target LOCAL doctor`、`--controller LOOPBACK doctor`；新增 `--timeout`，預設整體 10 秒。
38	- 預設本機、非互動、被動檢查。允許 controller GET 及本機 metadata；不發送外網測試、不呼叫 URLTest／healthcheck、不寫設定、不開 SSH、不啟動或修復服務，不改 TUN／系統代理／selector。
39	- 人類輸出為簡短分項檢查與具體下一步；JSON 為單一 typed report，含 schema version、scope、selection、checks、summary、建議。
40	- 項目狀態為 `pass / warn / fail / unknown / skip`。部分檢查失敗仍輸出其餘結果；明確標註「出口連通性未測試」。
41	- 退出碼：0 = 主要檢查完成且無 failure（允許 warning／可選 unknown）；1 = failure 或主要診斷未完成；2 = CLI 用法錯誤；130 = 取消。設定损壞屬診斷報告中的 failure，不在收集前直接退出。
42	
43	### 實作步驟與關鍵檔案
44	
45	1. **新增 `internal/doctor/run.go` 及測試**：共享聚合服務、typed report、可注入 collectors；避免放進 `diagnostics` 導致日後與 `managedcore` 循環引用。首版不整合服務 lifecycle，也不新增 TUI。
46	2. **設定與目標獨立處理**：使用 `config.Load`（`internal/config/config.go`），區別不存在的預設設定／明確指定檔案缺失／格式錯誤；環境與 OS 檢查不依赖設定載入成功。
47	   - 重用 `internal/proxyenv/resolve.go` 的 `IsLocalTarget`、local-default／單一候選／ambiguity 規則；必要時小幅抽取 selection 及 runtime endpoint helper，維持現有 `Resolve` 行為。
48	   - 分開 controller 身分與 data endpoint 的來源／優先序（包含 `LOCAL_PROXY_URL`），不能因 controller 離線就斷言代理 data path 故障。
49	   - 顯式遠端 target／SSH 不被偷換成本機：保留本機報告並標示 scope 不適用，不執行遠端連線。
50	3. **限制 discovery 在發送請求前只看本機**：在 `internal/connection/discovery.go` 增加可重用的 local-only 路徑，於 probe 前排除非 loopback／Unix candidates；保留既有 Discover 行為。不自動保存候選，不把零候選當成「沒有任何代理」。
51	4. **收集與判讀證據**：
52	   - 重用 `proxyenv.EnvironmentStatus`（`internal/proxyenv/probe.go`）取得已遮蔽的 process proxy variables。
53	   - 重用 `networkcheck.ReadSystemProxy`（`internal/networkcheck/system_proxy.go`）的 typed availability；macOS service 設定不代表每個 service 正在使用，unsupported 不等於 disabled。
54	   - 使用 `connection.Open(..., true)` 與一次 `/configs` snapshot 讀 controller identity、mode、ports、TUN；避免串接兩次 resolver／diagnostics.Test 重複請求。
55	   - 重用 `networkcheck.InspectWithOptions`（`internal/networkcheck/inspect.go`）的 capability 與必要介面／路由／DNS 證據，不搬入「新增 TUN 前」的整套 failure 判斷。
56	   - 比較同 scope 的 OS/env endpoint 與 runtime；不一致通常是 warning，不推定 ownership。TUN-only、無 proxy env、direct mode 本身均非故障。
57	   - 所有 collectors 有 bounded timeout／context cancellation，關閉 clients/helpers；不輸出 raw target、完整 config、PAC query、token、密碼或未遮蔽錯誤。
58	5. **新增 `internal/cli/doctor.go`**：薄 handler、human/JSON rendering；在 `internal/cli/root.go` 註冊並沿用既有 flag 驗證與 color/output 慣例。
59	   - `internal/cli/execute.go`／`root.go` 加窄範圍 typed reported outcome：報告成功輸出後才能帶非零 exit，不再印第二個 error envelope；其他命令退出與 error 契約不變。
60	6. **文件**：更新 `README.md`、`docs/diagnostics-and-routing.md`、必要的 embedded operating guide，説明 doctor 與主動測試的差別，以及現有 scoped doctors。
61	
62	### 驗證
63	
64	- Domain／CLI fixtures：正常、壞 TOML、缺設定、missing [REDACTED:generic-credential-uri]、401/403、offline、timeout、取消、多 target、default remote、explicit remote、IPv4/IPv6 loopback、Unix、TUN-only、缺 Python／unsupported OS backend。
65	- 安全契約：fake servers 限定本機只收到 GET version/configs；禁止 SSH、遠端 discovery、主動出口、mutating API、持久設定／session 寫入；env/config credentials 在 human/JSON 均遮蔽。
66	- 單一 JSON report、退出碼、writer error、help 無初始化；endpoint consistency 不錯判 TUN。
67	- `go test ./internal/doctor ./internal/cli ./internal/proxyenv ./internal/connection ./internal/networkcheck`；再 `go test ./...`，失敗如實報告。
68	- 建置 `./cmd/lazyclash` 到隔離的本機暫存位置；以新 binary 在這台 Mac 執行 human（PTY）及 JSON doctor，確認不改設定／selector／系統代理。保留 Homebrew binary。

70	## B. 用既有 az-backed 流程實測香港 HY2
71	
72	### 1. 再預檢與建立付費 VM
73	
74	- 使用新 binary，重新驗證上述 user／tenant／subscription、報價、quota、ARM Ubuntu image、inventory ID 不衝突。指定 `Standard_B2pts_v2`、Ubuntu 24.04 ARM64 的 pinned image、32 GiB disk、native backend；若缺容量或價格提高，停止回報，不自動升級機型或換區域／帳號。
75	- 以本機已載入的 `id_ed25519.pub` 作 SSH 公鑰。建立前辨識實際 SSH 管理路徑的出口 IPv4，將 TCP 22 限於該 `/32`；TUN／既有代理會影響出口，不能把任何 IP 查詢結果直接當實體網路出口。無法確定時請使用者提供管理 CIDR，絕不默認全網 SSH。
76	- 先 preview，再展示精確帳號、成本、資源、SSH CIDR、digest；取得**此階段付費資源核准**後才 apply：
77	
78	```sh
79	$LC vps create azure-hk-hy2 --provider azure \
80	  --subscription <AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID> \
81	  --region eastasia --plan Standard_B2pts_v2 --architecture arm64 \
82	  --disk-gb 32 --ssh-key "$HOME/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub" \
83	  --ssh-cidr "$ADMIN_CIDR" --json
84	# 以完全相同參數追加 --yes --expect "$VM_DIGEST"
85	```
86	
87	- 使用 `internal/vps/azure*.go` 的既有 az adapter／owned resource group／operation receipts。只建立一台，不碰既有資源。現有 NSG 開 TCP 80/443 與 UDP 443；HY2 使用 UDP 443、ACME 使用 TCP 80，無需新增管理 UI、Bastion、NAT Gateway 或付費 DNS zone。
88	- 部分／不確定建立結果先 status/resume reconcile，不能重試建第二台。
89	
90	### 2. DNS、SSH trust 與 HY2
91	
92	- 推薦在**新 VM 所屬 public-IP resource**上透過 `az network public-ip update --dns-name ... --subscription ...` 設唯一 Azure DNS label，讀回真實 `dnsSettings.fqdn`（通常 `LABEL.eastasia.cloudapp.azure.com`）。不需購買 domain、不猜測 FQDN；驗證公開 A／AAAA 正確。
93	- DNS 名稱及公開憑證會公開（包含 Certificate Transparency），於部署審核中説明。若 Azure hostname 的 ACME 簽發受限，停止處理再選可控 hostname；不用 self-signed 或 skip-cert-verify 繞過。
94	- SSH host key 經 Azure 已驗證控制面／console 比對後才加入 known_hosts；不使用 `StrictHostKeyChecking=no` 或僅信任未驗證的 ssh-keyscan。
95	- 確認 Ubuntu 24.04、sudo -n、Python/systemd、port binding／防火牆／DNS／ACME 前提。沿用 `internal/serverdeploy` 預檢与 receipt：
96	
97	```sh
98	$LC servers deploy hy2-hk --host azure-hk-hy2 \
99	  --recipe hysteria2 --backend native \
100	  --public-host "$VM_IP" --domain "$AZURE_FQDN" --obfs none --json
101	# 審核後，以相同參數追加 --yes --expect "$SERVER_DIGEST"
102	```
103	
104	- 首次不加 obfuscation／進階調優。省略可選 ACME email，避免不必要個資登記。確認 certbot.timer 與 renewal hook；TCP 80 保持可供續期。
105	- `internal/serverprobe/probe.go` 既有 isolated Mihomo 必須得到 authenticated HTTPS 成功與觀察到的 VM 出口。不得只根據 systemd running 或 exit 0 宣稱成功；`installed-unverified` 要如實處理。
106	- 本機既有 TUN 可能造成巢狀代理：查看 routes，必要時用既有 `--verify-interface` 指定經確認的實體介面；不為測試關掉現在的代理。區分端到端 HY2 成功與「本機直接到香港」已證實。
107	- 只做少量功能請求，不做大流量 benchmark；網路擋 UDP 時保留具體證據，不盲目加大 VM。
108	
109	### 3. 本機匯入，與切換流量分離
110	
111	- 顯式 target `local-clash-verge-rev`，重查 `configs source show`、Verge 當前 profile UID 與 selector，不能只信舊 registration；source binding 不一致則先停止，不直接改生成的 runtime YAML。
112	- HY2 獨立驗證通過後，透過既有 `servers connect`／`configwork` preview source diff、backup／receipt。新建 `HY2-Test` 群組，不更動父群組、rules 或現在 selection：
113	
114	```sh
115	$LC --target local-clash-verge-rev servers connect hy2-hk \
116	  --create-group HY2-Test --json
117	# 説明 reload 的影響並取得本機寫入核准，再追加 --yes --expect "$CLIENT_DIGEST"
118	$LC --target local-clash-verge-rev servers connect hy2-hk --verify --json
119	```
120	
121	- 匯入可能 reload；不能承諾完全無流量影響。unowned Verge 若回 `persisted_pending_owner_reload`，由使用者在 Verge 重載正確 profile 再驗證，不擅自繞過 owner。
122	- 驗證節點存在、source/runtime 一致、憑證與 node test 成功；不自動切換目前主代理。使用者另行要求切流量時才審核目標群組／成員並保留原 selection。
123	- 最後用 doctor 再檢查本機狀態，回報 VM identity/IP/FQDN、server verification、匯入／activation 狀態及仍未驗證事項；不印 client credentials。
124	
125	### 4. 回復與費用收尾
126	
127	- 分別保留 VM、server、client 的 receipts／可恢復狀態；不能把 timeout 視為沒有寫入。
128	- Client 回復用 configwork 原生 restore／verify，不覆寫整份 Verge 設定。
129	- 預設保留已建立的 VM 供使用，清楚告知持續費用；不擅自刪除。使用者選擇刪除時，先移除本次 client/server 關聯，再按 owned-resource preview 刪除本次 VM/disk/IP，確認實際資源均消失；deallocate 不等於清零費用。
130	- 正式雲端操作前跑相關 `./internal/vps ./internal/serverdeploy ./internal/serverprobe ./internal/configwork ./internal/cli` 測試。付費香港 VM、ACME/systemd 與本機真實代理的驗收要分開記錄，unit tests 不能替代。
131
